meta.title: BC Practical Exam Scenarios - EMR Trauma Set 1
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial practice scenarios modeled on EMALB exam format. Clinical content follows the BC Provincial Examination Guidelines (current to June 15, 2026) and is written to EMR scope of practice.

scenarios.titleEn: Construction Fall From 7.5 Metres - Multi-System Trauma With Spinal Injury
scenarios.titleZh: 建筑工地 7.5 米高处坠落——多发伤合并脊柱损伤
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0910 hrs. Code 3 to a four-storey wood-frame construction site on 152 Street in Surrey. A framer has fallen from the third floor to the ground. Surrey Fire is on scene, the site has been shut down and WorkSafeBC has been notified. Steady rain, 9 degrees C. You are the EMR crew; Royal Columbian Hospital trauma centre is 20 minutes by ground and a PCP car is 12 minutes behind you.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 09:10，Code 3 前往 Surrey 152 街一处四层木结构在建工地。一名木工从三楼坠落至地面。Surrey 消防已到场，工地已停工，WorkSafeBC（省工伤局）已接到通报。持续下雨，气温 9 摄氏度。你是 EMR 组；Royal Columbian 创伤中心地面转运 20 分钟，另有一辆 PCP 车在你之后 12 分钟到达。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: fire reports the worker fell approximately 7.5 metres onto compacted gravel, was unconscious for about half a minute, and is now awake but confused. His fall-arrest harness was not clipped in. Fire has stopped all overhead work and is holding the ladder access for you.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：消防报告伤者从约 7.5 米高处坠落至压实的碎石地面，昏迷约半分钟，现已清醒但意识模糊。他的防坠落安全带没有挂扣。消防已停止所有高处作业，并为你留好上下通道。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge the call and plan equipment before arrival: spinal device, hard collar, oxygen, suction, BVM, splints, blankets and the stretcher at the patient's side
expected.actionZh: 确认出车信息，并在到场前规划装备：脊柱固定装置、硬颈托、氧气、吸引器、BVM、夹板、保温毯，并把担架直接推到患者身边。

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch alone that a free fall greater than 6 metres meets the mechanism criteria for an unstable patient, and plan a Rapid Transport Category call
expected.actionZh: 仅凭派遣信息就判断出「自由坠落超过 6 米」已符合不稳定患者的受伤机制标准，并按 RTC（快速转运）方式规划整场处置。

expected.actionEn: Plan early for additional resources: confirm fire manpower for the lift and request the PCP car to intercept en route rather than waiting on scene for it
expected.actionZh: 提前安排额外资源：确认消防人员协助搬抬，并要求 PCP 车在途中会合，而不是留在现场等它到达。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Muddy site, steady rain, scaffolding overhead with work now stopped, loose lumber and exposed nails around the patient, a generator running nearby. The site superintendent meets you and confirms the machine and overhead hazards are locked out. One patient only. He is supine on wet gravel about 7.5 metres below the third-floor deck he fell from; his cracked hard hat is lying two metres away. Coworkers rolled him from his left side onto his back before you arrived.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：工地泥泞，雨一直下，头顶有脚手架但高处作业已停止，患者周围散落着木料和露出的钉子，附近有一台发电机在运转。工地主管前来迎接，确认机械和高处危险源均已锁定停机。现场只有一名患者。他仰卧在湿滑的碎石地上，正下方就是他坠落的三楼楼面，落差约 7.5 米；他破裂的安全帽掉在两米外。在你到达之前，工友已把他从左侧卧位翻成仰卧位。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (overhead work, nails, lumber, mud, generator - controlled by fire and the site superintendent), environment (cold rain), MOI (free fall 7.5 metres onto gravel, harness not clipped), people (one patient) and additional resources
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（高处作业、钉子、木料、泥泞、发电机——已由消防和工地主管控制）、环境（低温降雨）、受伤机制（自由坠落 7.5 米至碎石地面、安全带未挂扣）、人员（仅一名患者）以及所需的额外资源。

expected.actionEn: Don site-appropriate PPE: gloves and eye protection plus hard hat, high-visibility vest and boots for a construction site
expected.actionZh: 穿戴适合该现场的个人防护装备：手套和护目镜，另加建筑工地必需的安全帽、高可视背心和安全鞋。

expected.actionEn: First look: young adult male supine on wet gravel, awake but confused, pale, breathing fast and shallow, guarding the right chest with an obviously deformed left forearm
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：青壮年男性仰卧在湿碎石地上，清醒但意识模糊，面色苍白，呼吸又快又浅，护着右侧胸部，左前臂有明显畸形。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: eyes open, keeps asking 'what happened, what happened' and does not remember the fall. Says his chest and his belly hurt. EXAMINER (give only when assessed): airway is clear, no blood or vomit. Respirations 26, shallow, right chest tender with crepitus, air entry decreased at the right base, no flail segment, no open wound. Radial pulse 122, weak, regular. Skin pale, cool, clammy. RAPID BODY SURVEY: scalp abrasion left parietal with no depression; neck non-tender but he is confused; right lateral chest crepitus; abdomen firm and tender in the left upper quadrant; pelvis stable on one gentle assessment; closed deformity of the mid-left forearm with a present radial pulse and normal sensation; back checked during the scoop transfer with no step deformity; no external hemorrhage anywhere. SpO2 90% on room air. UNSTABLE: altered LOC, shock and a free fall over 6 metres.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：睁眼，反复问「发生什么事了、发生什么事了」，完全不记得坠落经过。诉胸部和腹部疼痛。考官（仅在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，无血液或呕吐物。呼吸 26 次/分、浅表，右侧胸壁压痛并可触及骨擦感，右肺底呼吸音减低，无连枷胸，无开放伤口。桡动脉搏动 122 次/分，细弱、规则。皮肤苍白、湿冷。快速体格检查（RBS）：左顶部头皮擦伤，无凹陷；颈部无压痛但患者意识模糊；右侧胸壁骨擦感；腹部左上腹紧张且压痛；骨盆轻柔评估一次，稳定；左前臂中段闭合性畸形，桡动脉搏动可及、感觉正常；背部在铲式担架转移时检查，无台阶样畸形；全身无外出血。室内空气下 SpO2 90%。不稳定判定：意识改变 + 休克 + 自由坠落超过 6 米。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: alert to voice but confused and amnesic to the event - this is an altered level of consciousness
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：能被言语唤醒但意识模糊、对事件失忆——这属于意识水平改变。

expected.actionEn: Take manual in-line c-spine control as your very first hands-on action and maintain it without release until the head is secured to the device
expected.actionZh: 把徒手轴线颈椎（C-spine）固定作为你上手的第一个动作，并全程不松手，直到头部被固定到脊柱固定装置上为止。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway with a jaw thrust technique; keep suction at the head of the patient because his LOC is decreased and he may vomit
expected.actionZh: 用推举下颌（jaw thrust）手法评估气道；因患者意识水平下降、随时可能呕吐，必须把吸引器放在他头侧随手可取。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: expose the chest, look-listen-feel, auscultate both sides, and recognize the shallow rate of 26 with decreased right basal air entry as inadequate ventilation requiring oxygen and readiness to assist with a BVM
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：暴露胸部，一看二听三感觉，双侧听诊，并认识到 26 次/分的浅快呼吸伴右肺底呼吸音减低属于通气不足，需要给氧并随时准备用 BVM 辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: radial pulse rate and quality, and interpret a weak pulse of 122 with pale cool clammy skin as shock from internal bleeding
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：检查桡动脉的频率与强弱，并把 122 次/分的细弱脉搏合并苍白湿冷皮肤解读为内出血导致的休克。

expected.actionEn: Perform a full rapid body survey head to toe, with a single gentle pelvic assessment and the back checked during the scoop transfer
expected.actionZh: 完成从头到脚的完整快速体格检查，骨盆只轻柔评估一次，背部在铲式担架转移时一并检查。

expected.actionEn: Recognize the firm tender left upper quadrant as a life threat you cannot fix on scene, and act on it by shortening the scene time rather than by continuing the secondary survey on the ground
expected.actionZh: 认识到左上腹紧张压痛是你在现场无法解决的致命威胁，据此缩短现场时间、尽快转运，而不是留在地上继续做二次评估。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin as pale, cool and clammy in the primary survey
expected.actionZh: 在初级评估中记录皮肤情况：苍白、发凉、湿黏。

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L via non-rebreather for trauma, shock, altered LOC and SpO2 90%; target SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 因创伤、休克、意识改变且 SpO2 只有 90%，用非重复呼吸面罩给 15 L 高流量氧，目标把 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上。

expected.actionEn: Position supine on a spinal device and get him off the cold wet gravel; blanket for warmth before the shock worsens
expected.actionZh: 仰卧位固定在脊柱固定装置上，尽快让他离开冰冷潮湿的碎石地面；在休克加重之前先盖毯保暖。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Altered LOC, shock, suspected intra-abdominal bleeding, suspected right-sided chest injury and a free fall over 6 metres all place this patient in the Rapid Transport Category. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Verbalize the destination decision: this patient meets trauma-centre criteria, so the closest trauma centre rather than the closest hospital.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。意识改变、休克、怀疑腹腔内出血、怀疑右侧胸部损伤，加上自由坠落超过 6 米，这些都把患者归入 RTC（快速转运）类别。15 分钟内必须完成打包、达到可装载状态。请口头说出目的地决策：该患者符合创伤中心收治标准，应送最近的创伤中心而不是最近的医院。

expected.actionEn: Categorize the patient as RTC out loud and act with visible urgency from that point on
expected.actionZh: 明确口头判定为 RTC，并从这一刻起用看得见的紧迫感行动。

expected.actionEn: Packaged on the spinal device and ready to be lifted onto the cot within 15 minutes; do the secondary survey en route
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内完成脊柱装置上的打包、达到可抬上担架床的状态；二次评估留到途中做。

expected.actionEn: State the destination decision (trauma centre) and arrange the PCP intercept en route instead of delaying scene departure
expected.actionZh: 说出目的地决策（创伤中心），并把与 PCP 车的会合安排在途中，而不是为此推迟离开现场。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS (confused, short sentences, needs questions repeated): 'I was on the third floor deck... I think I stepped back... I don't remember hitting the ground.' THE SUPERINTENDENT FILLS IN: free fall of about 7.5 metres straight to compacted gravel, nothing struck on the way down, landed on his left side then rolled onto his back with help from coworkers, unconscious about 30 seconds, no seizure, no medical complaint before the fall, harness worn but not clipped. PAIN: right chest 7/10 sharp and worse on breathing; left upper abdomen 6/10 dull and constant; left forearm 6/10. PMHx: borderline high blood pressure, no surgeries. Meds: none. Allergies: penicillin (rash). LOI: coffee and a muffin at 0700.
phases.infoZh: 演员回答（意识模糊、只能短句、需要重复提问）：「我当时在三楼楼面……我好像往后退了一步……我不记得摔到地上了。」工地主管补充：自由坠落约 7.5 米直落到压实碎石地面，下落途中没有撞到任何东西，先左侧着地再被工友帮忙翻成仰卧，昏迷约 30 秒，无抽搐，坠落前没有任何身体不适，安全带穿了但没有挂扣。疼痛：右胸 7/10，锐痛、呼吸时加重；左上腹 6/10，钝痛、持续；左前臂 6/10。既往史：血压偏高，无手术史。用药：无。过敏史：青霉素（皮疹）。最后进食：07:00 咖啡和一个松饼。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: chest and abdominal pain after a fall from height, with confusion
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：高处坠落后的胸痛与腹痛，并伴意识模糊。

expected.actionEn: Take the HxC/C with OPQRRRST and the critical fall questions: where from, height, free fall or struck objects, landing surface, what hit first, has he been moved, loss of consciousness, and what caused the fall
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST 采集现病史，并补齐坠落类必问项：从哪里坠落、高度多少、是否自由坠落还是途中撞到物体、落地面材质、身体哪个部位先着地、事后是否被移动过、有无意识丧失，以及坠落的原因是什么。

expected.actionEn: Score each pain complaint separately (chest, abdomen, forearm) and use a collateral history source because the patient is amnesic
expected.actionZh: 对每一处疼痛（胸部、腹部、前臂）分别评分；因患者失忆，必须向旁证（工地主管、工友）补充采集病史。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history
expected.actionZh: 既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications, including any blood thinners
expected.actionZh: 用药史，尤其要问清有没有在用抗凝或抗血小板药物。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake
expected.actionZh: 最后一次进食进饮。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (taken en route, first set completed in under 3 minutes): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6); BP 92/64; pulse 122 weak regular; respirations 26 shallow; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 90% on room air rising to 96% on 15 L; BGL 5.4 mmol/L (indicated because the LOC is altered); temperature 36.1 C (indicated because he was lying in cold rain). As a priority patient the second set is due 7-8 minutes after the first.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（途中测量，首组必须在 3 分钟内完成）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6）；血压 92/64；脉搏 122 次/分，细弱规则；呼吸 26 次/分、浅表；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 90%，给 15 L 氧后升至 96%；血糖 5.4 mmol/L（因意识改变而有测量指征）；体温 36.1 摄氏度（因躺在冷雨中而有测量指征）。作为优先（RTC）患者，第二组生命体征应在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components stated separately
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出睁眼、语言、运动三项的得分。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation; recognize a narrowing pulse pressure with a systolic of 92 as early decompensation
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压；认识到收缩压 92 且脉压变窄，是休克代偿开始失效的表现。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character, with both lung fields auscultated
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并听诊双肺。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on for colour, temperature and moisture
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤的颜色、温度和干湿。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size, equality and reaction, important with a head strike and amnesia
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——大小、是否等大、对光反应；本例有头部撞击和失忆，这一项尤其重要。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with the probe checked against the pulse, noting the reading is unreliable on a cold clammy finger
expected.actionZh: 测 SpO2 并核对波形/读数与实际脉搏是否一致，注意在湿冷手指上读数可能不准。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - indicated by the altered LOC, to rule out a medical cause for the fall
expected.actionZh: 血糖——因意识水平改变而有指征，用来排除坠落背后的内科原因。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated after prolonged exposure to cold rain on wet ground
expected.actionZh: 体温——患者长时间躺在冷雨湿地上，有测量指征。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, kept brief because the patient is a priority. ACTOR: general - healthy, works six days a week, no recent illness; CNS - no memory of the fall, headache 4/10, no limb weakness, no numbness; respiratory - hurts to take a deep breath, no cough, no blood; cardiovascular - heart is pounding, no chest pressure; GI/GU - nauseated, left upper abdomen aches and radiates to the left shoulder tip, no vomiting, no urinary complaint; integumentary - scalp abrasion and grazed left hip; musculoskeletal - left forearm and right ribs; endocrine - nil, no diabetes; EENT - vision blurred briefly after the fall, now clear.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，在途中进行，因患者属优先转运须从简。演员回答：全身健康——身体一向很好，每周工作六天，近期无疾病；中枢神经——完全不记得坠落过程，头痛 4/10，四肢无乏力、无麻木；呼吸——深吸气时疼痛，无咳嗽、无咯血；心血管——心跳得很重，无胸闷压榨感；消化/泌尿——恶心，左上腹隐痛并向左肩尖放射，无呕吐，排尿无异常；皮肤——头皮擦伤和左髋擦伤；肌肉骨骼——左前臂和右侧肋骨疼痛；内分泌——无异常，无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——坠落后短暂视物模糊，现已恢复清晰。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (amnesia and headache are pertinent to the head strike)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（失忆和头痛与头部撞击直接相关）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (pleuritic pain suggests rib injury or pneumothorax)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统（胸膜性疼痛提示肋骨损伤或气胸）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (left shoulder tip pain with LUQ tenderness is a classic referred sign of splenic injury)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（左上腹压痛伴左肩尖放射痛是脾脏损伤的典型牵涉痛表现）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - left parietal abrasion with a small hematoma, no depression, no blood or fluid from the ears or nose, trachea midline, no JVD, collar already on so the neck is inspected before the collar is applied and re-checked visually after; chest - right lateral tenderness with crepitus over ribs 6 to 9, air entry decreased at the right base, equal chest rise, no flail, no open wound; abdomen - firm and tender in the left upper quadrant, no distension yet, no seat-belt sign; back - inspected and palpated during the scoop transfer, grazed left flank, no step deformity; upper extremities - closed mid-shaft left forearm deformity, radial pulse present, sensation and movement intact in the fingers; lower extremities - grazed left hip, no deformity, distal pulses, sensation and movement all intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚检查：头颈——左顶部擦伤伴小血肿，无颅骨凹陷，耳鼻无血液或液体流出，气管居中，无颈静脉怒张；颈托在上之前先视诊并触诊颈部，上完颈托后再目视复查。胸部——右侧胸壁第 6 至 9 肋压痛并有骨擦感，右肺底呼吸音减低，胸廓起伏对称，无连枷胸，无开放伤口。腹部——左上腹紧张压痛，尚无膨隆，无安全带勒痕。背部——在铲式担架转移时视诊加触诊，左腰部擦伤，无台阶样畸形。上肢——左前臂中段闭合性畸形，桡动脉搏动可及，手指感觉与活动正常。下肢——左髋擦伤，无畸形，远端脉搏、感觉和运动均正常。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined before the collar goes on, including ears and nose for CSF or blood
expected.actionZh: 在上颈托之前完成头颈检查，包括查看耳道和鼻腔有无脑脊液或血液流出。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with auscultation at all six sites and palpation for crepitus and flail
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查：6 个听诊点全部听诊，并触诊有无骨擦感和连枷胸。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined in four quadrants; report the firm tender LUQ
expected.actionZh: 腹部按四个象限检查；报告左上腹紧张压痛这一发现。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the scoop transfer without a log roll onto the injured side
expected.actionZh: 在铲式担架转移时检查背部，不要为此把患者向受伤侧翻身。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with CSM documented above and below the forearm deformity
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查，并记录前臂畸形部位上下方的循环、感觉、运动（CSM）。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with distal pulses, sensation and motor function bilaterally
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查，双侧记录远端脉搏、感觉和运动功能。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE for this call: manual c-spine, hard collar, scoop or long board with head blocks and body straps (never tape the head), airway readiness with suction, high-flow oxygen with a BVM standing by, a simple splint to the forearm that does not delay departure, warmth, and rapid transport. ANALGESIA TRAP: Entonox is contraindicated here on two counts - altered level of consciousness, and a suspected pneumothorax from the right chest injury. Oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen are also inappropriate: he is confused, he is nauseated with a suspected intra-abdominal bleed and is likely heading for the operating room, and ibuprofen would worsen bleeding. State the contraindications out loud and withhold. OUT OF EMR SCOPE and not your job on this call: IV access, a fluid bolus, TXA, and CPAP - the PCP intercept or the trauma centre provides these.
phases.infoZh: 本次出车属于 EMR 授权范围内的处置：徒手颈椎固定、硬颈托、铲式担架或长脊板配头部固定块和身体约束带（绝不可用胶带缠头固定）、随时可用的吸引和气道管理、高流量氧并把 BVM 放在手边、给前臂做一个不耽误出发的简易夹板、保暖，以及快速转运。镇痛陷阱：本例 Entonox 有两条禁忌——意识水平改变，以及右胸损伤怀疑气胸。口服 acetaminophen 和 ibuprofen 同样不合适：患者意识模糊、恶心、怀疑腹腔内出血且很可能要进手术室，而 ibuprofen 还会加重出血。请把这些禁忌口头说出来并明确不给药。超出 EMR 范围、本场不该由你做的：静脉通路、液体复苏、TXA、CPAP——这些交给会合的 PCP 车或创伤中心。

expected.actionEn: Spinal management done correctly: manual stabilization held throughout, hard collar sized and applied, patient moved onto the device with a scoop rather than a log roll, head blocks and straps applied, head not taped
expected.actionZh: 脊柱固定做到位：全程保持徒手固定，选对尺寸并正确上硬颈托，用铲式担架而不是整体翻身把患者移上固定装置，装好头部固定块和约束带，不用胶带缠头。

expected.actionEn: Splint the deformed left forearm immobilizing the joint above and below, with CSM checked before and after, without delaying an RTC departure
expected.actionZh: 给畸形的左前臂上夹板，固定住损伤上下两个关节，上夹板前后各查一次 CSM，且不因此耽误 RTC 的出发时间。

expected.actionEn: Airway and breathing management: suction ready at the head, oxygen at 15 L, BVM within reach, and assisted ventilation started if tidal volume falls
expected.actionZh: 气道与呼吸管理：吸引器放在头侧随时可用，氧流量 15 L，BVM 放在伸手可及处，一旦潮气量不足立即开始辅助通气。

expected.actionEn: Rule out and verbalize the analgesia contraindications: no Entonox with an altered LOC or a suspected pneumothorax, and no oral analgesia with a suspected intra-abdominal bleed and possible surgery
expected.actionZh: 逐条排除并口头说明镇痛禁忌：意识改变或怀疑气胸时不得使用 Entonox；怀疑腹腔内出血、可能需要手术时不得口服镇痛药。

expected.actionEn: Cover with blankets and get him out of the rain early - hypothermia in a bleeding trauma patient makes the bleeding worse
expected.actionZh: 尽早盖毯保暖并让他脱离雨中——出血的创伤患者一旦低体温，出血会更难止住。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that IV fluid and TXA are outside EMR scope: transport now and take the PCP intercept en route rather than waiting on scene
expected.actionZh: 口头说明静脉补液和 TXA 超出 EMR 授权范围：立刻转运，在途中与 PCP 车会合，而不是留在现场等待。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after every move and at least every 5 minutes for this priority patient. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1): GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6); BP 86/58; pulse 130 weak; respirations 28 and shallower; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 94% on 15 L; abdomen now visibly distended. HE IS DETERIORATING. The correct response is to assist ventilations with a BVM, keep him warm and flat, update the receiving hospital, and keep driving - not to stop and re-examine.
phases.infoZh: 作为优先患者，每次搬动后以及至少每 5 分钟就要复评一次 ABC 和已做的处置。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟）：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6）；血压 86/58；脉搏 130 次/分、细弱；呼吸 28 次/分且更浅；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；15 L 氧下 SpO2 94%；腹部现在已经明显膨隆。患者正在恶化。正确的反应是：用 BVM 辅助通气、继续保暖并保持平卧、向接收医院更新病情、继续赶路——而不是停下来重新做检查。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each move and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和全部已实施的处置。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes of the first, and interpret the trend out loud as worsening haemorrhagic shock
expected.actionZh: 在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并口头解读这个趋势：失血性休克正在加重。

expected.actionEn: Recognize the falling GCS with shallower respirations and begin assisted ventilation with a BVM at 10-12 breaths per minute, keeping SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 认识到 GCS 下降合并呼吸变浅，立即用 BVM 以 10–12 次/分辅助通气，把 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上。

expected.actionEn: Keep suction in hand as the LOC drops; be ready to tip the whole spinal device if he vomits
expected.actionZh: 意识水平下降时把吸引器拿在手边；一旦呕吐，要能整块脊柱固定装置一起侧倾。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - trauma-centre notification en route, updated when he deteriorates. Hand-off must state the fall height, the loss of consciousness, the abdominal findings and the trend of the vital signs. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——途中就要向创伤中心预报，病情恶化后再更新一次。交接时必须说明坠落高度、意识丧失情况、腹部体征以及生命体征的变化趋势。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route trauma-centre notification with an update when the patient deteriorates
expected.actionZh: 途中向创伤中心预报，并在患者恶化后追加一次更新。

expected.actionEn: Complete verbal hand-off including the mechanism, the LOC, the abdominal findings and both sets of vitals
expected.actionZh: 完整的口头交接，包含受伤机制、意识丧失情况、腹部发现以及两组生命体征。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR completed within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR 书面记录。

criticalPitfallsEn: Not taking c-spine control, or letting go of it before the head is secured - failing to initiate or maintain C-spine control when indicated is a 100% deduction
Finding the firm tender abdomen and shock but continuing a full on-scene secondary survey instead of loading - identifying a life threat and failing to act is a 100% deduction
Giving Entonox for the chest or forearm pain - contraindicated with an altered LOC and with a suspected pneumothorax; failing to rule out contraindications is a 100% deduction

Missing the deterioration between vital sign sets and not assisting ventilations when the respirations become shallow with a falling GCS - determining inadequate breathing and not intervening is a 100% deduction

Treating this as non-RTC because the patient is still talking - a free fall over 6 metres with altered LOC and shock is Rapid Transport Category, and getting the transport category wrong is a 25% deduction
Staying on scene to wait for the PCP car so that IV fluid or TXA can be given - those are outside EMR scope and nothing about them justifies delaying transport
criticalPitfallsZh: 没有实施颈椎固定，或在头部尚未固定好之前就松手——有指征时未启动或未维持 C-spine 控制，扣 100%。
已经发现腹部紧张压痛和休克，却仍留在现场做完整的二次评估而不装车——发现致命威胁却不采取行动，扣 100%。
为胸痛或前臂痛给了 Entonox——意识改变和怀疑气胸都是禁忌；未排除全部禁忌证扣 100%。
没有发现两组生命体征之间的恶化，在呼吸变浅、GCS 下降时没有辅助通气——判断出呼吸不足却不干预，扣 100%。
因为患者还能说话就当成非 RTC 处理——自由坠落超过 6 米合并意识改变与休克属于 RTC，转运分类判断错误扣 25%。
为了等 PCP 车来上液体或 TXA 而滞留现场——这些本来就超出 EMR 范围，任何理由都不足以拖延转运。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR runs this call as a package-and-go: manual c-spine into a hard collar, scoop transfer onto the spinal device with blocks and straps, jaw thrust with suction at the head, high-flow oxygen with a BVM ready and used as he deteriorates, a quick forearm splint with CSM checks, blankets for warmth, and ready to lift within 15 minutes. All analgesia is withheld with the contraindications stated out loud - Entonox is barred by the altered LOC and the suspected pneumothorax, and oral acetaminophen and ibuprofen are barred by the suspected intra-abdominal bleed, the nausea and the likelihood of surgery. IV access, a fluid bolus, TXA and CPAP are all outside EMR scope; the correct EMR answer is early transport with a PCP intercept en route, not a longer scene time.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 跑这一场的核心就是「打包就走」：徒手固定颈椎后上硬颈托，用铲式担架把患者移上脊柱固定装置并装好头块和约束带，用推举下颌手法开放气道、吸引器放在头侧，给高流量氧并把 BVM 备在手边（患者恶化后立即使用），快速给前臂上夹板并前后各查一次 CSM，盖毯保暖，15 分钟内达到可抬上担架的状态。所有镇痛药都不给，并把禁忌逐条说出来——意识改变和怀疑气胸挡住了 Entonox，怀疑腹腔内出血、恶心以及很可能要手术挡住了口服 acetaminophen 和 ibuprofen。静脉通路、液体复苏、TXA 和 CPAP 全都超出 EMR 范围；EMR 的正确答案是尽早转运并在途中与 PCP 会合，而不是把现场时间拖长。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route, vascular access with a 20 mL/kg bolus to a maximum of 2 L reassessed every 500 mL and titrated to a systolic of 90, and TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute - indicated here because there is shock with a mechanism suggesting ongoing haemorrhage, within 3 hours, in a patient over 12 years, and this is not an isolated traumatic brain injury. PCP would also monitor for a developing tension pneumothorax on the right and reassess air entry after every ventilation change.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加：途中完成 9 系统功能问诊；建立静脉通路，20 mL/kg 快速补液（最多 2 升），每 500 mL 复评一次，滴定至收缩压 90；并给 TXA 2 g 静脉推注 1 分钟以上——本例符合指征，因为存在休克、受伤机制提示持续出血、在受伤 3 小时内、患者年龄超过 12 岁，且并非孤立性颅脑损伤。PCP 还应持续警惕右侧张力性气胸的形成，每次调整通气后都重新听诊呼吸音。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 34-year-old male framer who fell 7.5 metres in a free fall from a third-floor deck onto compacted gravel at 0905, landing on his left side. His harness was not clipped in. He was unconscious for about 30 seconds and remains amnesic to the event. Chief complaint is right chest pain 7 out of 10 and left upper abdominal pain 6 out of 10. On our primary he had an altered LOC, shallow respirations of 26 with decreased air entry at the right base and crepitus over the right lateral ribs, a weak radial pulse of 122, pale cool clammy skin, and a firm tender left upper quadrant. He also has a closed deformity of the left forearm with intact CSM. Initial vitals GCS 14, BP 92/64, pulse 122, resps 26, SpO2 90% on room air, BGL 5.4, temperature 36.1. Most recent vitals GCS 13, BP 86/58, pulse 130, resps 28, SpO2 94% on 15 litres, and his abdomen is now distended. History of borderline hypertension, no medications, allergic to penicillin with a rash, last ate at 0700. Treatments: manual in-line stabilization from first contact, hard collar, scoop transfer to a spinal device with blocks and straps, oxygen at 15 litres by non-rebreather, assisted ventilation with a BVM started 4 minutes ago, forearm splinted with CSM intact before and after, blankets, and rapid transport. All analgesia was withheld - Entonox because of the altered LOC and the suspected pneumothorax, and oral analgesia because of the suspected intra-abdominal bleed.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 34 岁男性木工，09:05 从三楼楼面自由坠落 7.5 米至压实碎石地面，左侧先着地，防坠落安全带没有挂扣。坠落后昏迷约 30 秒，至今对事件失忆。主诉为右胸痛 7/10 和左上腹痛 6/10。我们的初级评估发现：意识水平改变；呼吸 26 次/分、浅表，右肺底呼吸音减低，右侧胸壁可触及骨擦感；桡动脉搏动 122 次/分、细弱；皮肤苍白湿冷；左上腹紧张压痛。另有左前臂闭合性畸形，远端循环、感觉、运动完好。首组生命体征：GCS 14、血压 92/64、脉搏 122、呼吸 26、室内空气 SpO2 90%、血糖 5.4、体温 36.1。最新一组：GCS 13、血压 86/58、脉搏 130、呼吸 28、15 L 氧下 SpO2 94%，腹部现已膨隆。既往血压偏高，未服药，青霉素过敏（皮疹），07:00 最后进食。我们的处置：接触患者起即徒手轴线固定颈椎，上硬颈托，用铲式担架转移至脊柱固定装置并加头块和约束带，非重复呼吸面罩 15 L 给氧，4 分钟前开始用 BVM 辅助通气，前臂夹板固定且前后 CSM 均正常，盖毯保暖，快速转运。全部镇痛药均未给：Entonox 因意识改变和怀疑气胸而禁用，口服镇痛药因怀疑腹腔内出血而不宜。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Chest and abdominal pain with confusion after a 7.5 metre free fall at work
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Free fall 7.5 m from a third-floor deck onto compacted gravel at 0905, harness not clipped, nothing struck on the way down, landed left side, rolled supine by coworkers, LOC about 30 seconds, amnesic to the event, no medical complaint before the fall; chest pain 7/10 pleuritic, LUQ pain 6/10 with left shoulder tip radiation, forearm pain 6/10
treatments: Manual in-line c-spine stabilization from first contact, hard collar, scoop transfer, head blocks and straps, head not taped
Jaw thrust airway with suction at the head; BVM assisted ventilation started when GCS fell and respirations became shallow
Oxygen 15 L NRB, target SpO2 94% or above
Left forearm splinted, joints above and below immobilized, CSM intact before and after
Blankets and early removal from the wet cold scene
All analgesia withheld - Entonox contraindicated (altered LOC, suspected pneumothorax); oral analgesia withheld (suspected intra-abdominal bleed, nausea, likely surgery)
RTC to trauma centre with PCP intercept arranged en route
findings: Altered LOC, GCS 14 falling to 13, amnesic to the event
Right lateral rib crepitus with decreased air entry at the right base
Firm tender left upper quadrant progressing to visible distension
Shock: BP 92/64 falling to 86/58, pulse 122 rising to 130, pale cool clammy skin
Closed left forearm deformity with intact distal CSM
Left parietal scalp abrasion with a small hematoma, no depression, no CSF or blood from ears or nose

scenarios.titleEn: Ground-Level Fall in an 82-Year-Old - Hip Fracture on Anticoagulants
scenarios.titleZh: 82 岁老人平地跌倒——服用抗凝药者的髋部骨折
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1840 hrs. Code 2 to a seniors' independent living apartment on Bernard Avenue in Kelowna. An 82-year-old woman has fallen in her suite and cannot get up. Her daughter is with her and called 911. Warm, dry summer evening, 26 degrees C. No fire or police response. Kelowna General Hospital is 12 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 18:40，Code 2 前往 Kelowna Bernard 大道一处老年自理式公寓。一名 82 岁女性在自己的套房内跌倒后起不来。她女儿在旁并已拨打 911。夏日傍晚，天气温暖干燥，气温 26 摄氏度。消防和警察均未出动。Kelowna General 医院距离 12 分钟车程。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the patient is conscious and talking, complaining of right hip pain, and has been on the floor for about 20 minutes. The daughter says her mother takes a blood thinner. The building has an elevator and the suite is on the fourth floor with a narrow hallway.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：患者神志清楚、能对答，诉右髋疼痛，已在地上躺了约 20 分钟。女儿提到母亲在服用一种「血液稀释药」。楼内有电梯，套房在四楼，走廊很窄。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan equipment for a fourth-floor extrication down a narrow hallway: scoop stretcher, extra padding and pillows, blankets, stair chair if needed, and the drug kit
expected.actionZh: 确认信息，并针对四楼、窄走廊的搬运环境规划装备：铲式担架、额外的软垫和枕头、毯子、必要时的爬楼椅，以及药品箱。

expected.actionEn: Anticipate the two geriatric questions this call will turn on: why did she fall, and what does the anticoagulant change about her risk of bleeding
expected.actionZh: 提前想到这一场的两个老年评估关键问题：她为什么会跌倒，以及抗凝药会如何改变她的出血风险。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Tidy one-bedroom suite, good lighting, no hazards. A loose scatter rug is rucked up at the edge of the hallway. Her walker is standing three metres away by the kitchen. One patient, lying on her right side on the carpeted hallway floor between the bathroom and the bedroom, fully dressed, alert and apologetic. The daughter is calm and has not moved her. Room temperature is comfortable.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：一居室套房整洁、光线良好，无明显危险源。走廊边缘有一块散口地毯被踢卷起来。她的助行器放在三米外的厨房旁。现场只有一名患者：她右侧卧在铺地毯的走廊地面上，位置在浴室和卧室之间，衣着整齐，神志清醒并连声道歉。女儿情绪平静，没有移动过她。室温舒适。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none significant, note the rucked scatter rug as the likely trip hazard), environment, MOI (fall from standing height onto carpet), people (one patient plus a calm daughter) and resources
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（无重大危险，但要指出卷起的散口地毯很可能就是绊倒源）、环境、受伤机制（站立高度跌倒至地毯地面）、人员（一名患者加一位情绪平静的女儿）以及所需资源。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves; introduce yourself to the patient by name, get down to her eye level and ask permission before touching her
expected.actionZh: 戴手套；用姓名称呼并向患者自我介绍，蹲下与她平视，在动手检查前先征得她同意。

expected.actionEn: First look: elderly woman lying on her side, alert and oriented, in obvious pain, with the right leg visibly shortened and rotated outward; no blood on the floor
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：老年女性侧卧，神志清醒、定向力正常，明显疼痛，右下肢明显缩短并外旋；地面无血迹。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and fully oriented, GCS 15. 'I caught my foot on that rug. I went straight down on my right side. I never hit my head and I never blacked out - I remember all of it.' EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear and she is speaking full sentences; respirations 18, regular and unlaboured, good bilateral air entry; radial pulse 92, irregularly irregular (chronic atrial fibrillation), good volume; skin warm, dry and pink. RAPID BODY SURVEY: no head or neck injury and no midline cervical tenderness; chest and abdomen non-tender; PELVIS - do not spring it; right hip and groin are exquisitely tender, the right leg is shortened by about 3 cm and externally rotated; no external hemorrhage; left leg normal; both feet warm with strong pedal pulses, normal sensation and normal movement of the toes. SpO2 96% on room air. STABLE: no unstable criteria are met.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：神志清醒、定向力完整，GCS 15。「我的脚勾到那块地毯，整个人朝右边直接摔下去。我没有撞到头，也没有昏过去——整个过程我都记得。」考官（在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，能说完整句子；呼吸 18 次/分，规则、不费力，双肺呼吸音良好；桡动脉搏动 92 次/分，绝对不齐（慢性房颤），搏动有力；皮肤温暖、干燥、红润。快速体格检查：头颈无外伤，颈椎中线无压痛；胸腹无压痛；骨盆——不要做弹压试验；右髋及腹股沟区剧烈压痛，右下肢缩短约 3 厘米并外旋；无外出血；左下肢正常；双足温暖、足背动脉搏动有力，感觉正常，足趾活动正常。室内空气 SpO2 96%。判定为稳定：不符合任何不稳定标准。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: alert and oriented, GCS 15 - and say so, because an elderly patient's baseline mental status matters to the receiving team
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：清醒、定向力正常，GCS 15——并明确说出来，因为老年患者的基线精神状态对接收团队很重要。

expected.actionEn: Apply the NEXUS criteria out loud and correctly conclude spinal motion restriction is NOT indicated: no midline tenderness, no focal deficit, normal alertness, no intoxication, no distracting injury above the pelvis - but re-check if she reports any neck pain during movement
expected.actionZh: 口头逐条套用 NEXUS 标准，并正确得出「无需脊柱固定」的结论：颈椎中线无压痛、无神经功能缺损、意识正常、无中毒、骨盆以上无分散注意力的损伤——但只要她在搬动过程中诉颈部疼痛，就必须重新评估。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway - patent, speaking in full sentences
expected.actionZh: 评估气道——通畅，能说完整句子。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing with auscultation of both lung fields
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸，并听诊双侧肺野。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation: note the irregularly irregular pulse and ask whether that is normal for her, and look for the pallor or tachycardia that would suggest occult bleeding in an anticoagulated patient
expected.actionZh: 评估循环：注意到脉搏绝对不齐，并追问这对她是不是常态；同时留意有无苍白或心动过速——服用抗凝药的患者要警惕隐匿性出血。

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey head to toe with a gentle approach; do NOT spring or rock the pelvis, and check distal pulses, sensation and movement in both feet
expected.actionZh: 轻柔地完成从头到脚的快速体格检查；绝不可对骨盆做弹压或摇晃试验，并检查双足的远端脉搏、感觉和运动。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin as warm, dry and pink - normal perfusion
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：温暖、干燥、红润——提示灌注正常。

expected.actionEn: Oxygen is not indicated at SpO2 96% with normal work of breathing - state that and do not apply it reflexively
expected.actionZh: SpO2 96%、呼吸做功正常，没有给氧指征——请明确说出这一判断，不要条件反射式地给氧。

expected.actionEn: Position of comfort with the injured limb supported in the position found, using rolled blankets and pillows to eliminate motion at the hip
expected.actionZh: 采取舒适体位，用卷起的毯子和枕头在她被发现时的姿势下支撑住患肢，消除髋关节的活动。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. An isolated hip fracture is Rapid Transport Category ONLY if there is neurological or vascular impairment. Her distal pulses, sensation and movement are all intact, so this is a NON-RTC call: 30 minutes to be ready for transport, and the full secondary survey is completed on scene. Say the decision out loud, and say what would change it - loss of a pedal pulse, new numbness, or signs of shock would upgrade her immediately.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。孤立性髋部骨折只有在出现神经或血管损害时才属于 RTC。本例远端脉搏、感觉和运动均完好，因此属于非 RTC：有 30 分钟时间完成打包，二次评估可以在现场做完。请把这个决策口头说出来，同时说明什么情况会推翻它——足背动脉搏动消失、新出现的麻木，或出现休克征象，都要立即升级为 RTC。

expected.actionEn: Correctly categorize as non-RTC and state the reason: an isolated hip injury with intact neurovascular status distal to the injury
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC，并说明理由：孤立性髋部损伤，且损伤远端的神经血管功能完好。

expected.actionEn: State the findings that would upgrade her to RTC: an absent or weakening pedal pulse, new sensory or motor loss, or developing shock
expected.actionZh: 说出哪些发现会把她升级为 RTC：足背动脉搏动消失或减弱、新出现的感觉或运动障碍，或出现休克表现。

expected.actionEn: Ready for transport within 30 minutes, having planned the route out of a fourth-floor suite through a narrow hallway before the patient is moved
expected.actionZh: 在 30 分钟内达到可转运状态，并在搬动患者之前就先规划好从四楼套房经窄走廊出楼的路线。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS (clear, cooperative, embarrassed): tripped on the rug and fell straight onto her right side about 20 minutes ago, no dizziness, no palpitations, no chest pain and no shortness of breath before the fall, did not faint, no head strike, no LOC. Pain is in the right groin, 8/10, sharp with any movement and a deep ache at rest, radiating to the knee, nothing makes it better. She has not tried to stand. PMHx: atrial fibrillation, hypertension, osteoporosis, cataract surgery, one previous wrist fracture. Meds: apixaban, metoprolol, ramipril, calcium and vitamin D. Allergies: sulfa - hives. LOI: soup and tea at 1730.
phases.infoZh: 演员回答（表达清楚、配合、有些不好意思）：大约 20 分钟前被地毯绊倒，整个人直接摔在右侧；跌倒前没有头晕、没有心慌、没有胸痛也没有气促；没有晕厥，没有撞到头，没有意识丧失。疼痛位于右腹股沟，8/10，任何活动都是锐痛，静止时是深部钝痛，向膝部放射，没有任何办法能缓解。她没有尝试站起来。既往史：心房颤动、高血压、骨质疏松、白内障手术，曾有一次腕部骨折。用药：apixaban（阿哌沙班）、metoprolol、ramipril、钙片和维生素 D。过敏史：磺胺类——荨麻疹。最后进食：17:30 喝了汤和茶。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: right hip pain and inability to stand after a fall
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：跌倒后右髋疼痛、无法站立。

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST plus the critical fall questions, and specifically hunt for a medical cause: dizziness, palpitations, chest pain, shortness of breath, syncope, new medications, or a fall that was witnessed as a collapse rather than a trip
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST 采集现病史并补齐坠落/跌倒必问项，尤其要主动排查内科病因：有无头晕、心悸、胸痛、气促、晕厥、近期换药，以及旁人看到的到底是「绊倒」还是「突然瘫软倒地」。

expected.actionEn: Pain score before and after any analgesia and before and after moving her
expected.actionZh: 在给药前后、以及搬动前后分别做疼痛评分。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history, including previous fractures and osteoporosis
expected.actionZh: 既往病史，包括既往骨折史和骨质疏松。

expected.actionEn: Medications - identify apixaban as an anticoagulant and recognize both that it raises her bleeding risk and that it contraindicates ibuprofen
expected.actionZh: 用药史——识别出 apixaban 是抗凝药，并同时意识到两点：它提高了她的出血风险，而且它使 ibuprofen 成为禁忌。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake - relevant because she is heading for surgery
expected.actionZh: 最后进食进饮——她很可能要手术，所以这一项与麻醉直接相关。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (on scene): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 148/86; pulse 92 irregularly irregular, good volume; respirations 18 regular unlaboured; skin warm dry pink; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 96% on room air; BGL 6.2 mmol/L (reasonable in an unwitnessed geriatric fall to rule out a hypoglycaemic cause); temperature 36.8 C. As a non-priority patient the second set is due within 17-18 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（现场）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 148/86；脉搏 92 次/分，绝对不齐但搏动有力；呼吸 18 次/分，规则、不费力；皮肤温暖干燥红润；瞳孔等大有反应；室内空气 SpO2 96%；血糖 6.2 mmol/L（老年人无旁证目击的跌倒，测一次以排除低血糖病因是合理的）；体温 36.8 摄氏度。作为非优先患者，第二组生命体征应在 17–18 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出三项分值。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure by auscultation; compare it with her usual readings and be alert that a normal or high pressure does not exclude bleeding in an older patient on antihypertensives
expected.actionZh: 用听诊法测血压；与她平时的血压对比，并警惕：老年人本身在服降压药时，血压正常甚至偏高也不能排除出血。

expected.actionEn: Pulse - describe the irregularly irregular rhythm and confirm it is her known atrial fibrillation
expected.actionZh: 脉搏——描述其绝对不齐的节律，并确认这是她已知的房颤而非新发。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤。

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔。

expected.actionEn: SpO2
expected.actionZh: 血氧饱和度（SpO2）。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - justified in an older adult who has fallen, to rule out hypoglycaemia as the cause
expected.actionZh: 血糖——老年人跌倒时测一次是合理的，用来排除低血糖这一跌倒诱因。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - a long lie on the floor and possible infection as a fall precipitant both justify it
expected.actionZh: 体温——长时间躺在地上，以及感染可能是跌倒诱因，这两点都支持测量体温。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, completed on scene because she is stable. ACTOR: general - has been more tired lately, appetite good, no weight loss, uses a walker outdoors but not indoors; CNS - no dizziness, no headache, no confusion, no previous stroke, no numbness; respiratory - no cough, no shortness of breath; cardiovascular - known atrial fibrillation, no chest pain, occasional ankle swelling; GI/GU - no abdominal pain, no vomiting, no blood in the stool or urine, has not passed urine since the fall; integumentary - thin fragile skin, a large bruise already forming over the right hip; musculoskeletal - severe right hip pain, no other joints hurt, previous wrist fracture; endocrine - no diabetes, no thyroid problems; EENT - cataract surgery both eyes, wears a hearing aid in the left ear.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，因患者稳定可在现场完成。演员回答：全身健康——最近容易疲倦，胃口尚好，无体重下降，外出时用助行器、在家里不用；中枢神经——无头晕、无头痛、无意识模糊、无卒中史、无麻木；呼吸——无咳嗽、无气促；心血管——已知房颤，无胸痛，偶有脚踝水肿；消化/泌尿——无腹痛、无呕吐、大小便无血，跌倒后还没有小便；皮肤——皮肤菲薄脆弱，右髋部已开始形成大片瘀斑；肌肉骨骼——右髋剧痛，其余关节无不适，既往腕部骨折；内分泌——无糖尿病、无甲状腺疾病；眼耳鼻喉——双眼白内障手术史，左耳佩戴助听器。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health (frailty, mobility aids and recent decline are the key geriatric threads)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康（衰弱程度、助行器使用情况和近期功能下降是老年评估的关键线索）。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (ruling out a neurological cause for the fall)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（用于排除跌倒的神经系统病因）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (atrial fibrillation and a possible arrhythmic cause for the fall)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统（房颤本身，以及心律失常导致跌倒的可能）。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (occult bleeding on an anticoagulant, and urinary retention after a long lie)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（抗凝状态下的隐匿出血，以及长时间躺卧后的尿潴留）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (fragile skin and pressure areas after 20 minutes on the floor)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤（皮肤脆弱，以及在地上躺 20 分钟后的受压部位）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (hearing aid and vision affect how you communicate with her)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉（助听器和视力直接影响你和她的沟通方式）。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe on scene: head/neck - no injury, no midline cervical tenderness on gentle palpation, no bruising behind the ears; chest - no tenderness, equal air entry at all six sites; abdomen - soft and non-tender, no distension; back - inspected during the scoop transfer, no tenderness, an old kyphosis noted so pad the voids under the head and shoulders; upper extremities - a small skin tear on the right forearm from the fall, CSM intact; lower extremities - right leg shortened about 3 cm and externally rotated with an early large hip bruise, exquisite groin tenderness, dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses strong bilaterally, sensation and toe movement normal bilaterally, left leg entirely normal.
phases.infoZh: 现场从头到脚检查：头颈——无外伤，轻柔触诊颈椎中线无压痛，耳后无瘀斑；胸部——无压痛，6 个听诊点呼吸音对称；腹部——柔软无压痛，无膨隆；背部——在铲式担架转移时检查，无压痛，可见陈旧性驼背，因此必须在头颈和肩背下方的空隙处加软垫；上肢——右前臂有跌倒造成的小块皮肤撕脱伤，远端 CSM 完好；下肢——右下肢缩短约 3 厘米并外旋，髋部已见大片早期瘀斑，腹股沟区剧烈压痛，双侧足背动脉和胫后动脉搏动有力，双侧感觉与足趾活动正常，左下肢完全正常。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined gently, including behind the ears, in an anticoagulated patient who might have struck her head without realizing it
expected.actionZh: 轻柔检查头颈部（包括耳后）——服用抗凝药的患者可能自己没意识到撞了头。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with six-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查，6 个位置听诊。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined - occult retroperitoneal bleeding is a real risk on an anticoagulant
expected.actionZh: 腹部检查——服用抗凝药者存在腹膜后隐匿出血的真实风险。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the scoop transfer, with the kyphosis padded rather than forced flat
expected.actionZh: 在铲式担架转移时检查背部，对驼背处加垫填充，而不是硬把她压平。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities including the skin tear and CSM
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查，包括皮肤撕脱伤和 CSM。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with the shortening and rotation measured and both pedal pulses, sensation and movement documented before and after every move
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查：记录缩短与外旋的程度，并在每次搬动前后都记录双侧足背动脉搏动、感觉和运动。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE: support the injured limb in the position found using helpers, rolled blankets and pillows between the legs, then move her onto a firm blanketed scoop or spinal device and secure her so that motion at the hip is eliminated. Pad the voids under her kyphotic back, head and heels - thin fragile skin over 12 minutes of transport still matters. Keep her warm even in summer. ANALGESIA BEFORE MOVEMENT: acetaminophen 500-1,000 mg PO is appropriate, and Entonox self-administered before you move her is appropriate once you have completed the primary survey, investigated the pain, obtained baseline vitals with SpO2 and ruled out the contraindications. IBUPROFEN IS CONTRAINDICATED - she takes an anticoagulant; say so out loud, because withholding a drug for a documented contraindication is not the same as forgetting it. BINDER TRAP: do NOT apply a pelvic binder. A neck-of-femur fracture and a simple fall from standing height are both explicit contraindications to binding. OUT OF EMR SCOPE: IV access, IV acetaminophen and ondansetron for the nausea Entonox may cause.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围内的处置：先由助手配合，用卷毯和放在两腿之间的枕头，在她被发现时的姿势上支撑住患肢；然后把她移到铺好毯子的硬质铲式担架或脊柱固定装置上并固定，使髋关节完全不能活动。要在她驼背的背部、头部和足跟下方的空隙加垫——12 分钟的转运对菲薄脆弱的老年皮肤同样会造成压伤。即使是夏天也要注意保暖。搬动前镇痛：口服 acetaminophen 500–1,000 mg 是合适的；在完成初级评估、问清疼痛情况、取得含 SpO2 的基线生命体征并逐条排除禁忌之后，让她在搬动前自行吸入 Entonox 也是合适的。Ibuprofen 属于禁忌——她在服抗凝药；请把这一点明确说出来，因为「有明确禁忌而不给」和「忘了给」在评分上完全不同。骨盆固定带陷阱：不要上骨盆固定带。股骨颈（髋部）骨折与站立高度的简单跌倒，都是骨盆绑扎的明确禁忌。超出 EMR 范围：静脉通路、静脉用 acetaminophen，以及为 Entonox 可能引起的恶心而给 ondansetron。

expected.actionEn: Stabilize the injured limb where it lies using helpers, rolled blankets and a pillow between the legs, then move her with a scoop onto a firm padded surface and secure her to eliminate hip movement
expected.actionZh: 在原位用助手、卷毯和两腿之间的枕头稳住患肢，再用铲式担架把她移到铺垫良好的硬质平面上并固定牢，使髋部完全不能活动。

expected.actionEn: Administer acetaminophen 500-1,000 mg PO before moving her, after confirming she has taken none in the past 4 hours and has no liver disease
expected.actionZh: 在搬动之前给口服 acetaminophen 500–1,000 mg，给药前先确认她过去 4 小时内没有服过该药、且没有肝病。

expected.actionEn: Offer self-administered Entonox before the move, after baseline vitals with SpO2 and after ruling out the contraindications - she is alert, can comply, and the suite can be ventilated
expected.actionZh: 在搬动前提供由患者自行吸入的 Entonox：先取得含 SpO2 的基线生命体征，并逐条排除禁忌——她意识清醒、能够配合，房间也可以通风。

expected.actionEn: Explicitly withhold ibuprofen and state the reason: she is on the anticoagulant apixaban, which is a listed contraindication
expected.actionZh: 明确不给 ibuprofen，并说出理由：她在服抗凝药 apixaban，这是该药说明书上列明的禁忌。

expected.actionEn: Do NOT apply a pelvic binder; verbalize that a neck-of-femur fracture and a fall from standing height are both contraindications to binding
expected.actionZh: 不要上骨盆固定带；并口头说明股骨颈骨折和站立高度跌倒都是骨盆绑扎的禁忌。

expected.actionEn: Geriatric care details: pad the voids for the kyphosis and heels, keep her warm, keep her glasses and hearing aid with her, explain each step before you do it, and bring her medication list and the daughter's contact information
expected.actionZh: 老年照护细节：在驼背处和足跟下加垫填空、注意保暖、把眼镜和助听器随身带上、每做一步之前先说明，并带上她的用药清单和女儿的联系方式。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, pain and distal neurovascular status after every move: off the floor, onto the cot, into the elevator, into the ambulance. Set 2 (in the ambulance, 15 minutes after set 1, after acetaminophen and Entonox and after packaging): GCS 15; BP 138/80; pulse 88 irregular; respirations 16 regular; skin warm dry pink; pupils equal; SpO2 97% on room air; pain now 4/10 at rest; right pedal pulses still strong with normal sensation and toe movement.
phases.infoZh: 每一次搬动之后都要复评 ABC、疼痛和远端神经血管状况：从地面抬起时、移上担架床时、进电梯时、进救护车时。第 2 组（车上，第 1 组之后 15 分钟，已给 acetaminophen 和 Entonox 并完成打包）：GCS 15；血压 138/80；脉搏 88 次/分、不齐；呼吸 16 次/分、规则；皮肤温暖干燥红润；瞳孔等大；室内空气 SpO2 97%；静息疼痛降至 4/10；右足背动脉搏动仍然有力，感觉与足趾活动正常。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each of the four moves
expected.actionZh: 在这四次搬动之后，每次都复评 ABC 和已实施的处置。

expected.actionEn: Recheck distal pulses, sensation and movement in the injured leg after every move and document each check
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后都重新检查患肢远端脉搏、感觉和运动，并逐次记录。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 17-18 minutes for a non-priority patient
expected.actionZh: 非优先患者，第二组完整生命体征应在 17–18 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: Re-score the pain after analgesia and after the move, and document the response
expected.actionZh: 在给药后和搬动后重新做疼痛评分，并记录镇痛效果。

phases.infoEn: Non-priority patient - routine notification is sufficient, but the anticoagulant must be flagged clearly to the triage nurse. Hand-off must include the time of the fall, the anticoagulant and its last dose, the analgesia given and its effect, and the fact that neurovascular status has been intact throughout. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 非优先患者——常规通报即可，但必须向分诊护士明确标出她在服抗凝药。交接内容必须包括：跌倒时间、抗凝药名称及最后一次服药时间、已给的镇痛药及其效果，以及全程神经血管功能均完好这一事实。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Notification appropriate to a non-priority patient, flagging the anticoagulant
expected.actionZh: 按非优先患者做适当通报，并特别标注抗凝药。

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off including analgesia given, the response to it, and serial neurovascular checks
expected.actionZh: 完整交接，包含已给的镇痛药、用药后的反应，以及历次神经血管检查结果。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes, documenting why ibuprofen was withheld
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，并写清为什么没有给 ibuprofen。

vitalsSets.timeHint: in the ambulance, 15 minutes later, after analgesia and packaging

criticalPitfallsEn: Applying a pelvic binder to this patient - a neck-of-femur fracture and a fall from standing height are both explicit contraindications, and binding here is an incorrect intervention detrimental to patient care
Giving ibuprofen without checking the medication list - she takes apixaban, and anticoagulant use is a listed contraindication; failing to rule out contraindications is a 100% deduction
Calling this RTC without any neurovascular impairment, or missing an RTC upgrade if a pedal pulse disappears - getting the transport category wrong is a 25% deduction

Immobilizing her spine reflexively because she fell - she passes NEXUS, and strapping a frail kyphotic patient to a hard board causes harm; conversely, ignoring any neck pain she reports during the move is the opposite error

Moving her before any analgesia, or giving acetaminophen only and skipping Entonox before a painful move - not administering Entonox when it is indicated is a 25% deduction, and delaying it until after you have moved or manipulated the limb is a 100% deduction
Never asking why she fell - an unexamined syncope, arrhythmia, hypoglycaemia or infection is the finding that gets missed in geriatric fall scenarios
criticalPitfallsZh: 给这位患者上骨盆固定带——股骨颈骨折和站立高度跌倒都是明确禁忌，在这里绑扎属于错误干预并损害患者照护。
没有核对用药清单就给了 ibuprofen——她在服 apixaban，抗凝药是该药明列的禁忌；未排除禁忌证扣 100%。
在没有任何神经血管损害的情况下判为 RTC，或在足背动脉搏动消失后没有及时升级为 RTC——转运分类判断错误扣 25%。
因为「她摔倒了」就条件反射地做脊柱固定——她通过了 NEXUS 标准，把驼背的衰弱老人绑在硬板上本身就是伤害；反过来，如果她在搬动中诉颈痛而你置之不理，那就是另一个方向的错误。
没有任何镇痛就直接搬动，或只给了 acetaminophen、在痛苦的搬动前没有给 Entonox——有指征却不给 Entonox 扣 25%，而拖到搬动或骨折处理之后才给则扣 100%。
自始至终没有追问「她为什么会跌倒」——晕厥、心律失常、低血糖或感染，正是老年跌倒场景里最常被漏掉的那个发现。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: Everything this call needs is inside EMR scope: NEXUS applied and spinal motion restriction correctly withheld, the limb supported in the position found with blankets and pillows, a scoop transfer onto a padded firm surface with the hip immobilized, warmth, pressure-area padding for fragile skin, acetaminophen 500-1,000 mg PO, and self-administered Entonox before the move. The two EMR judgement calls that carry the marks are withholding ibuprofen because of the apixaban, and withholding the pelvic binder because a neck-of-femur fracture from a standing-height fall is a contraindication to binding. Both must be verbalized, not silently skipped. IV analgesia and antiemetics are out of scope.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一场需要的所有处置都在 EMR 授权范围内：套用 NEXUS 标准并正确地不做脊柱固定；用毯子和枕头在原位支撑患肢；用铲式担架把她移到铺垫良好的硬质平面上并固定住髋部；保暖；为脆弱皮肤在受压部位加垫；口服 acetaminophen 500–1,000 mg；搬动前让她自行吸入 Entonox。真正拿分的是两个 EMR 判断题：因为在服 apixaban 而不给 ibuprofen，以及因为「站立高度跌倒导致的股骨颈骨折」属于禁忌而不上骨盆固定带。这两点都必须口头说出来，不能只是默默跳过。静脉镇痛和止吐药超出 EMR 范围。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry, vascular access if the transport is long or the pain is severe, IV acetaminophen 1,000 mg over 15 minutes for a patient 50 kg or more as an alternative to oral, and ondansetron 8 mg PO or IV if Entonox makes her nauseated. PCP should also consider whether an occult retroperitoneal or intracranial bleed is developing on the anticoagulant and reassess the abdomen and LOC serially.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加：9 系统功能问诊；若转运时间长或疼痛剧烈可建立静脉通路；体重 50 kg 及以上者可用静脉 acetaminophen 1,000 mg 输注 15 分钟以上替代口服；若 Entonox 引起恶心可给 ondansetron 8 mg 口服或静脉。PCP 还应考虑抗凝状态下是否正在形成腹膜后或颅内隐匿出血，并连续复评腹部体征与意识水平。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is an 82-year-old woman who tripped on a scatter rug at approximately 1820 and fell from standing height onto her right side on carpet. There was no head strike and no loss of consciousness, and she is clear that she tripped rather than collapsed - no dizziness, palpitations, chest pain or shortness of breath beforehand. Chief complaint is right groin pain, initially 8 out of 10. Our findings are a shortened and externally rotated right leg with exquisite groin tenderness and an early large hip bruise; distal pulses, sensation and toe movement have been intact bilaterally at every check. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 148/86, pulse 92 irregularly irregular consistent with her known atrial fibrillation, resps 18, SpO2 96% room air, BGL 6.2, temperature 36.8. Latest vitals BP 138/80, pulse 88, resps 16, SpO2 97%, pain now 4 out of 10. History of atrial fibrillation, hypertension and osteoporosis with a previous wrist fracture. Important medication: she takes apixaban, last dose this morning - please flag that. Allergic to sulfa with hives, last ate soup and tea at 1730. Treatments: limb supported in the position found with blankets and a pillow between the legs, scoop transfer onto a padded firm surface with the hip immobilized, voids padded for her kyphosis, acetaminophen 1,000 milligrams by mouth at 1858, and self-administered Entonox before the move. Ibuprofen was withheld because of the apixaban, and no pelvic binder was applied because this is a neck-of-femur fracture from a standing-height fall.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一位 82 岁女性，约 18:20 被一块散口地毯绊倒，从站立高度朝右侧摔在地毯地面上。没有撞到头，没有意识丧失；她很确定是「被绊倒」而不是「突然瘫软倒下」——事前没有头晕、心悸、胸痛或气促。主诉为右腹股沟疼痛，最初 8/10。我们的发现是：右下肢缩短并外旋，腹股沟区剧烈压痛，髋部已见大片早期瘀斑；每一次检查中双侧远端脉搏、感觉和足趾活动都是完好的。首组生命体征：GCS 15、血压 148/86、脉搏 92 次/分绝对不齐（与其已知房颤相符）、呼吸 18、室内空气 SpO2 96%、血糖 6.2、体温 36.8。最新一组：血压 138/80、脉搏 88、呼吸 16、SpO2 97%，疼痛降至 4/10。既往有房颤、高血压和骨质疏松，曾有腕部骨折。重要用药：她在服 apixaban，最后一次是今天早上——请特别留意这一点。磺胺类过敏（荨麻疹），17:30 最后进食汤和茶。我们的处置：在她被发现时的姿势下用毯子和两腿间枕头支撑患肢，用铲式担架移到铺垫良好的硬质平面上并固定髋部，在驼背空隙处加垫，18:58 口服 acetaminophen 1,000 mg，搬动前让她自行吸入 Entonox。因为在服 apixaban 所以没有给 ibuprofen；因为这是站立高度跌倒造成的股骨颈骨折，所以没有使用骨盆固定带。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Right hip pain and inability to weight bear after a ground-level fall
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Tripped on a scatter rug at 1820, fell from standing height onto the right side on carpet, on the floor about 20 minutes; no head strike, no LOC, no preceding dizziness, palpitations, chest pain or shortness of breath; groin pain 8/10 sharp on movement, radiating to the knee, reduced to 4/10 after analgesia
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Atrial fibrillation, hypertension, osteoporosis, previous wrist fracture, bilateral cataract surgery
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Apixaban, metoprolol, ramipril, calcium, vitamin D
