scenarios.titleEn: Winter Snowmobile Crash - Trauma Complicated by Moderate Hypothermia
scenarios.titleZh: 冬季雪地摩托事故——创伤合并中度低体温
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1905 hrs, January. Code 3 to a forest service road off Highway 5 near Merritt. A snowmobile has struck a buried stump and the rider was thrown. His two friends found him about 45 minutes after the crash and rode out to a spot with cell service to call. Air temperature minus 12 degrees C, light snow, full dark. Search and Rescue will bring the patient to the highway pullout by rescue toboggan; fire is staging with you at the pullout. Royal Inland Hospital in Kamloops is 55 minutes by ground and air ambulance is unavailable due to weather.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 1 月 19:05，Code 3 前往 Merritt 附近 5 号公路旁的一条林业道路。一辆雪地摩托撞上埋在雪下的树桩，驾驶者被抛出。两名同伴在事故约 45 分钟后才找到他，然后骑车到有信号的地方报警。气温零下 12 摄氏度，小雪，天已全黑。搜救队（SAR）会用救援雪橇把患者运到公路边的停车带；消防与你一同在停车带待命。Kamloops 的 Royal Inland 医院地面转运 55 分钟，因天气原因空中救护无法出动。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the friends report the rider is awake but 'not making sense', his clothing is wet because he went through the slushy edge of a creek, and he was lying in the snow the whole time. They have covered him with one jacket. SAR estimates 10 minutes to reach you at the pullout.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：同伴报告伤者虽然清醒但「说话颠三倒四」，因为压破了小溪边缘的融雪层，衣服已经湿透，而且他一直躺在雪地里。他们只给他盖了一件外套。搜救队预计 10 分钟后把他送到停车带与你会合。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and prepare the ambulance before the patient arrives: heat the patient compartment to 30 degrees C, lay out dry blankets, warm packs and towels, and have the scoop, collar, splints and shears ready
expected.actionZh: 确认信息，并在患者到达之前把救护车准备好：把车厢加热到 30 摄氏度，铺好干燥毯子，备好加热包和包裹用的毛巾，同时准备好铲式担架、颈托、夹板和剪刀。

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a combined problem: this is a trauma patient AND an environmental patient, and both have to be managed at once - hypothermia will not wait until the fractures are splinted
expected.actionZh: 预判这是一个「双重问题」：既是创伤患者也是环境急症患者，两者必须同时处置——低体温不会等你把骨折固定完再发作。

expected.actionEn: Plan for a long transport with no air option: confirm the destination, tell dispatch the ground ETA and ask whether a PCP or ALS intercept can meet you en route
expected.actionZh: 按「长途转运且没有空中选项」来规划：确认目的地，把地面到院时间告知调度，并询问能否安排 PCP 或高级生命支持车在途中会合。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Highway pullout, snow-packed and icy, dark, minus 12 degrees C with a light wind. Fire has set up scene lighting and closed the shoulder lane; a plough truck passes intermittently. SAR arrives with the patient strapped in a rescue toboggan, still in wet snowmobile gear, wrapped in a foil blanket over the wet clothing. One patient. He is moving his head, mumbling, and is not shivering. His friends are with SAR and can give history.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：公路边的停车带，地面积雪结冰，天黑，零下 12 摄氏度，有微风。消防已架好照明并封闭了路肩车道；铲雪车不时驶过。搜救队用救援雪橇把患者送到，患者仍穿着湿透的雪地摩托服，湿衣服外面裹着一层锡箔保温毯，已用固定带绑在雪橇上。现场只有一名患者。他能转动头部、口齿含糊地咕哝，而且没有在发抖。他的同伴随搜救队一起到达，可以提供病史。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (ice, traffic on the shoulder, plough truck, darkness, cold to the crew), environment (minus 12 C, dark, wind), MOI (snowmobile versus buried stump at speed, rider thrown, 45 minutes lying in snow) and people (one patient plus witnesses)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（结冰路面、路肩车流、铲雪车、黑暗、以及低温对救护人员自身的威胁）、环境（零下 12 摄氏度、天黑、有风）、受伤机制（雪地摩托高速撞上埋雪树桩、驾驶者被抛出、在雪中躺了 45 分钟）和人员（一名患者外加可提供证词的同伴）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection plus cold-weather and high-visibility gear; get the patient into the heated ambulance before doing anything you can do inside instead of outside
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜，并穿好防寒服与高可视装备；凡是能在车内做的事，就先把患者搬进已加热的车厢再做。

expected.actionEn: First look: young adult male, wet clothing, mumbling and confused, NOT shivering - the absence of shivering in a cold patient means the hypothermia is no longer mild
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：青壮年男性，衣服湿透，口齿含糊、意识模糊，而且没有在发抖——低体温患者一旦不再发抖，说明已经不是轻度低体温了。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: mumbles, opens eyes to voice, gives confused answers, tries to pull away when touched. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway is clear but he is slow to protect it; respirations 12, shallow and slow; radial pulse cannot be found - take 30 to 45 seconds and check the carotid, which is 48, weak and regular. Skin is cold, pale and waxy, with no shivering. RAPID BODY SURVEY: helmet on and intact, no head wound; neck cannot be cleared because he is confused; chest tender on the left with equal air entry; abdomen soft; pelvis stable; obvious closed deformity of the left lower leg with the boot still on, foot cool - but both feet are cold, so compare with the uninjured side; no external hemorrhage. SpO2 probe will not pick up a reading on his cold fingers. Tympanic temperature 30.5 C. UNSTABLE: altered LOC, bradycardia with poor perfusion, and moderate hypothermia.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：口齿含糊，能被言语唤醒睁眼，回答混乱，被触碰时会往回缩。考官（在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，但他保护气道的能力已经变差；呼吸 12 次/分，浅而慢；桡动脉摸不到——必须用 30 至 45 秒去摸颈动脉，为 48 次/分、细弱、规则。皮肤冰冷、苍白、蜡样，且没有寒战。快速体格检查：头盔完好戴在头上，无头部伤口；因意识模糊无法排除颈椎损伤；左侧胸壁压痛，双肺呼吸音对称；腹部柔软；骨盆稳定；左小腿有明显闭合性畸形，靴子还穿着，该足冰凉——但双足都是凉的，必须与健侧对比判断；全身无外出血。血氧探头在他冰冷的手指上读不出数值。鼓膜体温 30.5 摄氏度。不稳定判定：意识改变、心动过缓伴灌注不良、以及中度低体温。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to voice, confused - an altered LOC in a cold patient is a hypothermia sign, not just a head injury sign
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：对言语有反应但意识模糊——低体温患者的意识改变本身就是低体温的表现，不能只往颅脑损伤上想。

expected.actionEn: Manual in-line c-spine control and keep it: a thrown rider who is confused cannot be cleared by NEXUS, so spinal precautions stay on
expected.actionZh: 实施并保持徒手轴线颈椎固定：被抛出的驾驶者且意识模糊，无法用 NEXUS 排除颈椎损伤，因此脊柱防护必须全程保留。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway; keep suction ready because a cold confused patient protects his airway poorly and may vomit
expected.actionZh: 评估气道；并把吸引器备好，因为低体温合并意识模糊的患者气道保护能力差、随时可能呕吐。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing: recognize a slow shallow rate of 12 as inadequate ventilation, give oxygen and assist ventilations gently with a BVM without hyperventilating the cold heart
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸：认识到 12 次/分的慢而浅呼吸属于通气不足，给氧并用 BVM 轻柔辅助通气，注意不要对低体温的心脏过度通气。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation taking a full 30 to 45 seconds to determine pulselessness in a severely cold patient - do not declare arrest on a 10 second check
expected.actionZh: 评估循环时，对严重低体温患者必须用足 30 至 45 秒来判断有无脉搏——绝不能凭 10 秒的检查就判定为心搏骤停。

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey with the wet clothing cut away in the heated compartment, then immediately re-covered - expose in sections, never strip and leave him uncovered
expected.actionZh: 在已加热的车厢内剪开湿衣服完成快速体格检查，检查完立刻重新盖好——分段暴露，绝不能一次脱光后晾着。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin: cold, pale and waxy with no shivering, and say what that means - shivering stops below roughly 32 degrees, so this is at least moderate hypothermia
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：冰冷、苍白、蜡样，且已无寒战；并说出其含义——体温大致低于 32 摄氏度后寒战就会停止，所以这至少是中度低体温。

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen; the pulse oximeter is unreliable on cold peripheries so treat on clinical grounds rather than waiting for a number
expected.actionZh: 给高流量氧；末梢冰冷时血氧仪读数不可靠，应根据临床表现处置，而不是干等一个数字。

expected.actionEn: Position supine, flat and still on a scoop; avoid any rough handling, jolting or unnecessary movement, which can trigger ventricular fibrillation in a cold heart
expected.actionZh: 用铲式担架保持平卧、平稳、不动；避免任何粗暴搬动、颠簸或不必要的活动——低体温的心脏可能因此触发室颤。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Altered LOC, a bradycardic pulse of 48 with poor perfusion, moderate hypothermia at 30.5 C and a high-energy mechanism all make this Rapid Transport Category. Ready to load within 15 minutes. This is one of the few calls where scene time and gentle handling pull against each other: move once, move slowly, but move now. Destination is the trauma centre at Royal Inland, 55 minutes away, so rewarming en route matters as much as the splint.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。意识改变、脉搏 48 次/分的心动过缓伴灌注不良、体温 30.5 摄氏度的中度低体温，加上高能量受伤机制，都把患者归入 RTC。15 分钟内完成打包。这是少数几种「现场时间」与「轻柔搬动」互相拉扯的出车：只搬一次、慢慢搬，但现在就要搬。目的地是 55 分钟车程外的 Royal Inland 创伤中心，因此途中复温和夹板固定同样重要。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and state all four reasons: altered LOC, bradycardia with poor perfusion, hypothermia and the mechanism
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC，并说出全部四条理由：意识改变、心动过缓伴灌注不良、低体温、以及受伤机制。

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes while still handling him gently - one careful scoop transfer rather than several moves
expected.actionZh: 在 15 分钟内完成装载准备，同时保持轻柔搬动——用一次仔细的铲式担架转移代替反复多次搬动。

expected.actionEn: Use SAR and fire personnel for the lift and for equipment so that your hands stay on the patient's airway and c-spine
expected.actionZh: 让搜救队和消防人员负责搬抬和器材传递，好让你的手始终留在患者的气道和颈椎固定上。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS (slurred, slow, gives up halfway through sentences; you will get most of this from his friends): riding a groomed trail at roughly 50 km/h, hit a stump buried under fresh snow, went over the handlebars and landed on his left side about 8 metres away. Helmet on, no full-face damage. The friends were ahead and did not see the crash; they came back 45 minutes later and found him lying in the snow, awake but confused, one leg obviously bent. He had gone through the slushy edge of a creek earlier so his snow pants and gloves were already soaked. Pain: left lower leg 7/10 and left ribs 5/10, though he minimizes it and keeps trying to sit up. PMHx per friends: healthy, no medications. Allergies: none known. Last oral intake: a burger and two beers at 1500 - four hours ago.
phases.infoZh: 演员回答（口齿含糊、反应迟缓，句子说到一半就放弃；大部分信息要从同伴那里获得）：当时在压好的雪道上以约 50 km/h 行驶，撞上被新雪掩埋的树桩，人从车头翻出去，落在约 8 米外、左侧着地。戴着头盔，全盔无破损。同伴当时骑在前面，没有看到事故发生；45 分钟后折返才找到他躺在雪地里，人是醒着但意识模糊，一条腿明显弯折。他更早时压破了小溪边缘的融雪层，所以雪裤和手套早就湿透了。疼痛：左小腿 7/10，左侧肋骨 5/10，但他自己一直轻描淡写还想坐起来。既往史（同伴代述）：身体健康，无用药。过敏史：无已知过敏。最后进食：15:00 吃了汉堡、喝了两瓶啤酒——距今四小时。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: leg and chest pain with confusion after a snowmobile crash and prolonged cold exposure
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：雪地摩托事故合并长时间低温暴露后的小腿与胸部疼痛，并伴意识模糊。

expected.actionEn: HxC/C using collateral history from the friends, covering speed, what he struck, distance thrown, landing position, helmet, LOC, AND the environmental history: how long down, wet clothing, wind exposure, any alcohol
expected.actionZh: 通过同伴采集现病史，内容涵盖车速、撞到什么、被抛出的距离、落地姿势、有无戴头盔、有无意识丧失，并且必须补齐环境史：躺了多久、衣服是否湿透、有无风吹暴露、有无饮酒。

expected.actionEn: Pain score for each complaint, recognizing that a hypothermic confused patient under-reports pain
expected.actionZh: 对每一处疼痛分别评分，并意识到低体温合并意识模糊的患者往往会低估、少报疼痛。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history from the friends
expected.actionZh: 通过同伴采集既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake, including the alcohol - it worsens heat loss and clouds the mental status picture
expected.actionZh: 最后进食进饮，包括饮酒情况——酒精会加重散热，也会干扰对意识状态的判断。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (in the heated ambulance): GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6); BP 96/62, difficult to auscultate over road noise - use palpation if you must and say that you did; pulse 48 weak and regular at the carotid, radial not palpable; respirations 12 shallow; skin cold pale waxy, not shivering; pupils equal and sluggish; SpO2 will not read on cold fingers, so document 'unobtainable'; BGL 4.4 mmol/L; tympanic temperature 30.5 C - MODERATE hypothermia.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（在已加热的救护车内）：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6）；血压 96/62，因行车噪音听诊困难——必要时用触诊法测量并如实说明；脉搏颈动脉 48 次/分、细弱规则，桡动脉触不到；呼吸 12 次/分、浅表；皮肤冰冷、苍白、蜡样，无寒战；瞳孔等大、对光反应迟钝；SpO2 在冰冷手指上无法读出，应记录为「无法测得」；血糖 4.4 mmol/L；鼓膜体温 30.5 摄氏度——属于中度低体温。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出三项分值。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure - state the method used and why, since auscultation is unreliable in a cold vasoconstricted patient in a noisy compartment
expected.actionZh: 测血压——说明所用方法及原因：低体温血管收缩的患者在嘈杂车厢内听诊本就不可靠。

expected.actionEn: Pulse taken centrally over a full 30 to 45 seconds, with rate, rhythm and quality reported
expected.actionZh: 在中心动脉处用足 30 至 45 秒测脉搏，并报告频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character, recognizing 12 and shallow as inadequate in this patient
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质；对这位患者而言，12 次/分且浅表就属于通气不足。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on - cold, waxy, no shivering
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤——冰冷、蜡样、无寒战。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - sluggish reaction is consistent with hypothermia as well as head injury
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——对光反应迟钝既可由低体温引起，也可由颅脑损伤引起。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 attempted and documented as unobtainable, with the reason given
expected.actionZh: 尝试测量 SpO2，若无法测得则如实记录为「无法测得」并说明原因。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - mandatory here because the LOC is decreased and hypoglycaemia both mimics and worsens hypothermia
expected.actionZh: 血糖——本例必测：患者意识水平下降，而低血糖既会模仿低体温的表现，也会加重低体温。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - this is the vital sign that decides the treatment path, so measure it and repeat it
expected.actionZh: 体温——这是决定整个治疗方向的那项生命体征，必须测量并反复复测。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, abbreviated because he is a priority patient and drifts off mid-answer. ACTOR: general - fit, rides every weekend, no recent illness; CNS - confused, does not remember the crash clearly, no limb weakness he can describe, hands 'don't work'; respiratory - hurts on the left when he breathes in; cardiovascular - no chest pressure; GI/GU - nauseated, no vomiting, has not urinated; integumentary - fingers and toes white and numb with no blistering; musculoskeletal - left lower leg pain; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - no visual complaint, helmet visor was down.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，因患者属优先转运且回答到一半就走神，须从简。演员回答：全身健康——身体健康，每个周末都骑车，近期无疾病；中枢神经——意识模糊，对事故经过记不清楚，说不出具体的肢体无力，只说双手「不听使唤」；呼吸——吸气时左侧疼痛；心血管——无胸闷压榨感；消化/泌尿——恶心，无呕吐，事故后未排尿；皮肤——手指和脚趾发白、麻木，尚无水疱；肌肉骨骼——左小腿疼痛；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无视觉不适，头盔面罩当时是放下的。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (confusion here has two possible causes, head injury and hypothermia, and both must be reported)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（本例的意识模糊有两个可能来源：颅脑损伤和低体温，交接时两者都要报告）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (white numb digits raise local cold injury on top of the systemic hypothermia)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤（手指脚趾发白麻木提示在全身性低体温之上还叠加了局部冻伤）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe in the heated compartment, exposing one region at a time and re-covering it: head/neck - helmet removed by two rescuers with in-line stabilization, no scalp wound, no blood from the ears, collar applied; chest - left lateral tenderness over ribs 8 to 10 with equal air entry, no flail, no crepitus; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - checked during the scoop transfer, no step deformity, clothing soaked through to the skin; upper extremities - fingers white and hard to the touch with reduced sensation, no blisters, CSM otherwise intact; lower extremities - closed mid-shaft tibia-fibula deformity on the left, boot removed carefully, foot pale and cold with a weak but present dorsalis pedis pulse that is the same as the uninjured side, sensation reduced in both feet.
phases.infoZh: 在加热车厢内做从头到脚检查，每次只暴露一个部位、查完立刻盖回：头颈——由两名救护员维持轴线固定后摘除头盔，无头皮伤口，耳道无出血，随即上颈托；胸部——左侧第 8 至 10 肋压痛，双肺呼吸音对称，无连枷胸，无骨擦感；腹部——柔软、无压痛；背部——在铲式担架转移时检查，无台阶样畸形，衣物已湿透贴身；上肢——手指发白、触之发硬、感觉减退，尚无水疱，其余循环感觉运动正常；下肢——左侧胫腓骨中段闭合性畸形，小心脱下靴子后见足部苍白冰冷，足背动脉搏动微弱但可及，且与健侧一致，双足感觉均减退。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined during a controlled two-rescuer helmet removal with in-line stabilization maintained
expected.actionZh: 在两名救护员配合、全程维持轴线固定的受控摘盔过程中完成头颈检查。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with six-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查，6 个位置听诊。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined
expected.actionZh: 腹部检查。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the scoop transfer and the wet clothing removed from underneath him, not just from the front
expected.actionZh: 在铲式担架转移时检查背部，并把他身下的湿衣物一并去除，而不是只脱正面的。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities examined for local cold injury as well as trauma, comparing both hands
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查时既要看创伤也要看局部冻伤，并对比双手。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with the deformity documented and the distal pulse compared against the uninjured limb, because every extremity is cold in this patient
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查记录畸形，并把患侧远端脉搏与健侧对比——本例患者四肢本来就都是冰凉的。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE, and the two problems run in parallel. TRAUMA SIDE: two-rescuer helmet removal with in-line stabilization, hard collar, one gentle scoop transfer, splint the left tib-fib with the joints above and below immobilized and CSM compared to the other leg, oxygen and gentle assisted ventilation. ENVIRONMENTAL SIDE at 30.5 C this is MODERATE hypothermia, so you ACTIVELY rewarm: cut off every piece of wet clothing, dry him, wrap him in dry blankets, keep the compartment at 30 degrees, and apply hot packs WRAPPED IN TOWELS to the trunk - armpits, chest and groin - never directly on skin and never to the limbs. Do NOT allow mild activity, do NOT rub or massage the limbs, and do NOT give anything by mouth. If he had been below 28 degrees you would insulate only and NOT actively rewarm. ANALGESIA: Entonox is contraindicated by the altered LOC, methoxyflurane by the altered LOC, and oral analgesia by his confusion - splinting and gentle handling are the analgesia here. OUT OF EMR SCOPE: IV access and warmed IV fluid, CPAP, TXA.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围内的处置，而且创伤和环境这两条线要同时推进。创伤这一侧：两人配合摘头盔并全程维持轴线固定、上硬颈托、只做一次轻柔的铲式担架转移、给左侧胫腓骨上夹板并固定住上下两个关节、把患侧 CSM 与健侧对比，同时给氧并轻柔辅助通气。环境这一侧：体温 30.5 摄氏度属于中度低体温，因此要主动复温——剪掉每一件湿衣服、把身体擦干、裹上干燥毯子、车厢维持 30 摄氏度，并把加热包用毛巾包好后放在躯干（腋下、胸部、腹股沟），绝不可直接贴皮肤，也绝不可放在四肢。不要让他活动，不要揉搓或按摩四肢，不要经口给任何东西。如果体温低于 28 摄氏度，则只做保温隔热、不主动复温。镇痛：意识改变使 Entonox 成为禁忌，也使 methoxyflurane 成为禁忌，意识模糊使口服镇痛不可行——本例的「镇痛」就是把骨折固定好、把人搬得足够轻柔。超出 EMR 范围：静脉通路与加温静脉液体、CPAP、TXA。

expected.actionEn: Remove ALL wet clothing by cutting, dry the skin, and wrap in dry blankets inside the heated compartment before anything else that can wait
expected.actionZh: 在加热车厢内，先把所有湿衣服剪开脱掉、擦干皮肤、裹上干燥毯子，其余能等的事都往后排。

expected.actionEn: Actively rewarm for moderate hypothermia: ambulance heated to 30 degrees C, warm blankets, and hot packs wrapped in towels applied to the trunk only - never directly on skin and never on the extremities
expected.actionZh: 按中度低体温主动复温：车厢加热到 30 摄氏度、盖加温毯、加热包用毛巾包好只放躯干——绝不直接接触皮肤，也绝不放在四肢。

expected.actionEn: Handle him gently throughout: one transfer, no jolting, no rubbing or massaging cold limbs, no sitting him up - rough handling can precipitate ventricular fibrillation in a cold heart
expected.actionZh: 全程轻柔搬动：只转移一次、不颠簸、不揉搓按摩冰冷的肢体、不让他坐起来——粗暴搬动可能诱发低体温心脏的室颤。

expected.actionEn: Two-rescuer helmet removal with in-line stabilization, hard collar and a single scoop transfer onto the spinal device
expected.actionZh: 两名救护员配合摘除头盔并维持轴线固定，上硬颈托，用一次铲式担架转移把患者移上脊柱固定装置。

expected.actionEn: Splint the left tib-fib immobilizing the joints above and below, with distal circulation, sensation and movement compared against the uninjured leg before and after
expected.actionZh: 给左侧胫腓骨上夹板并固定住上下两个关节，上夹板前后都把远端循环、感觉、运动与健侧对比检查。

expected.actionEn: Give oxygen and assist ventilations gently with a BVM; do not hyperventilate and do not give anything by mouth to a confused hypothermic patient
expected.actionZh: 给氧并用 BVM 轻柔辅助通气；不要过度通气，也不要给意识模糊的低体温患者经口进任何东西。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize that all analgesia is withheld and why: Entonox and methoxyflurane are contraindicated by the altered LOC, and oral drugs are unsafe in a confused patient
expected.actionZh: 口头说明所有镇痛药都不给以及原因：意识改变使 Entonox 和 methoxyflurane 均属禁忌，意识模糊的患者口服给药也不安全。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, temperature and the splint every 5 minutes on a 55 minute transport, and be ready for cardiac arrest at any point. Set 2 (30 minutes into transport, after wet clothing removal and active rewarming): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6); BP 104/68; pulse 58 stronger and now palpable at the radial; respirations 14; skin cold but no longer waxy, shivering has restarted; pupils equal, reaction improving; SpO2 now reads 95% on 15 L as the fingers warm; temperature 31.4 C. He is improving. EXAMINER NOTE: if the candidate asks what to do should he arrest, the correct answer is CPR, apply the AED and analyze, defibrillate up to three times if indicated, then continue CPR without pausing for further analysis, and transport.
phases.infoZh: 在长达 55 分钟的转运中，每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC、体温和夹板，并随时准备应对心搏骤停。第 2 组（转运 30 分钟时，已脱除湿衣物并主动复温）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6）；血压 104/68；脉搏 58 次/分且较前有力，桡动脉现在可以摸到；呼吸 14 次/分；皮肤仍凉但已不再是蜡样，寒战重新出现；瞳孔等大，对光反应改善；手指回暖后 SpO2 在 15 L 氧下可读出 95%；体温 31.4 摄氏度。患者在好转。考官提示：若考生询问「万一他心跳停了怎么办」，正确答案是：开始 CPR、贴上 AED 并分析、如有指征最多除颤三次，之后继续 CPR 不再为分析或电击而中断，同时继续转运。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each move and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和全部处置。

expected.actionEn: Repeat the temperature and report the rewarming trend, not just a single number
expected.actionZh: 反复复测体温，并报告复温的变化趋势，而不是只报一个孤立数值。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes of the first for a priority patient, then repeated through the long transport
expected.actionZh: 优先患者的第二组完整生命体征应在第一组之后 7–8 分钟内完成，之后在长途转运中持续重复测量。

expected.actionEn: Recheck distal circulation, sensation and movement below the splint against the uninjured leg after every move
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后都重新检查夹板远端的循环、感觉和运动，并与健侧对比。

expected.actionEn: State the hypothermic arrest plan: CPR, AED analyze, up to three shocks if indicated, then continue CPR without pausing to analyze again, and keep transporting
expected.actionZh: 说出低体温心搏骤停的处置计划：CPR、AED 分析、如有指征最多三次电击，之后继续 CPR 不再为分析而暂停，并持续转运。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient on a long transport - notify early and update. Hand-off must state the down time in the snow, the initial and current core temperature, exactly what rewarming was done, and that the wet clothing was removed at what time. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 长途转运的优先患者——要尽早预报并中途更新。交接时必须说明：在雪地里躺了多久、初始与当前的核心体温、具体做了哪些复温措施，以及湿衣物是几点脱除的。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Early notification to the receiving trauma centre with the core temperature included
expected.actionZh: 尽早向接收创伤中心预报，并在预报内容中包含核心体温。

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off covering both the trauma and the environmental picture, including the rewarming timeline
expected.actionZh: 完整交接，创伤和环境两条线都要讲清，并包含复温的时间线。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes, documenting temperatures, the pulse check duration and the rewarming measures
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，记录各次体温、检查脉搏所用的时长，以及采取的复温措施。

vitalsSets.pulse: 48 weak regular at the carotid, radial not palpable

vitalsSets.timeHint: 30 minutes into transport, after wet clothing removal and active rewarming
vitalsSets.skin: cold but not waxy, shivering has restarted

criticalPitfallsEn: Declaring pulselessness after a 10 second check - in the severely cold patient you must take 30 to 45 seconds before concluding there is no pulse
Leaving him in wet clothing under a blanket because it is cold outside - wet clothing must be cut off and the skin dried, or nothing you do will rewarm him
Applying hot packs directly to skin or to the arms and legs - packs go wrapped in towels on the trunk only; warming the limbs first drives cold blood back to the core
Rough handling, letting him sit up, or rubbing his limbs to warm them - all can precipitate ventricular fibrillation in a hypothermic heart
Treating only the fracture and forgetting the environmental protocol, or treating only the hypothermia and never splinting - both halves of this call are graded
Actively rewarming as though he were severe (under 28 C) or insulating only as though he were mild - at 30.5 C this is moderate hypothermia and active rewarming is correct
Giving Entonox or an oral analgesic to a confused hypothermic patient - altered LOC is an explicit contraindication
criticalPitfallsZh: 用 10 秒钟检查就判定没有脉搏——对严重低体温的患者，必须用 30 至 45 秒才能下「无脉」的结论。
因为外面天冷就让他穿着湿衣服盖毯子——湿衣服必须剪开脱掉、皮肤必须擦干，否则你做什么都无法给他复温。
把加热包直接贴在皮肤上或放在四肢——加热包必须用毛巾包好且只放躯干；先加温四肢会把冷血赶回核心循环。
粗暴搬动、让他坐起来，或者揉搓四肢取暖——这些都可能诱发低体温心脏的室颤。
只处理骨折而忘了环境急症的处置流程，或者只顾复温而始终没有上夹板——这一场的两半都在评分范围内。
把他当成重度（低于 28 摄氏度）只做保温不复温，或反过来当成轻度处理——30.5 摄氏度属于中度低体温，主动复温才是正确做法。
给意识模糊的低体温患者用 Entonox 或口服镇痛药——意识改变是明列的禁忌。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: This whole call sits inside EMR scope and that is the point: removing wet clothing, drying, insulating, heating the compartment to 30 degrees, trunk-only wrapped hot packs, gentle handling, two-rescuer helmet removal, collar and scoop, a tib-fib splint with comparative CSM checks, oxygen and gentle BVM support, a 30 to 45 second pulse check, and readiness to run CPR with the AED using the hypothermic three-shock rule. All analgesia is withheld for altered LOC. What EMR cannot do here - warmed IV fluid, CPAP - is exactly what makes the mechanical basics decisive on a 55 minute transport.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一整场都落在 EMR 授权范围内，而这正是本场的用意：脱除湿衣、擦干、保温隔热、车厢加热到 30 摄氏度、用毛巾包好的加热包只放躯干、全程轻柔搬动、两人配合摘头盔、上颈托与铲式担架、给胫腓骨上夹板并与健侧对比查 CSM、给氧并轻柔用 BVM 支持通气、用 30 至 45 秒检查脉搏，以及随时准备按低体温「最多三次电击」规则跑 CPR 加 AED。因意识改变，所有镇痛药一律不给。EMR 在这里做不了的（加温静脉液体、CPAP）恰恰说明：在 55 分钟的转运里，这些最基础的机械性操作才是决定成败的关键。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry, vascular access with warmed fluid if hypotension persists after rewarming begins, and closer airway management if the LOC falls further. PCP must still follow the same hypothermia rules: no active rewarming below 28 degrees, trunk-only heat packs, and a 30 to 45 second pulse check before declaring arrest.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加：9 系统功能问诊；若开始复温后仍持续低血压，则建立静脉通路并输注加温液体；若意识水平进一步下降，则加强气道管理。但 PCP 同样必须遵守低体温的基本规则：低于 28 摄氏度不做主动复温、加热包只放躯干、判定心搏骤停前必须用足 30 至 45 秒检查脉搏。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 27-year-old male snowmobile rider who struck a buried stump at approximately 50 kilometres an hour at about 1800, went over the handlebars and landed on his left side roughly 8 metres away. He was helmeted with no helmet damage. He lay in the snow for about 45 minutes before his friends found him, and his clothing was already soaked from going through a creek edge earlier. Chief complaint is left lower leg pain 7 out of 10 and left rib pain 5 out of 10, and he is confused. On arrival he was not shivering, with a tympanic temperature of 30.5, GCS 13, no palpable radial pulse and a carotid rate of 48 found over a 45 second check, respirations 12 and shallow, BP 96/62 by palpation, skin cold pale and waxy, SpO2 unobtainable, BGL 4.4. Current vitals GCS 14, BP 104/68, pulse 58 now palpable at the radial, resps 14, SpO2 95% on 15 litres, temperature 31.4, and he has started shivering again. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies, last ate at 1500 with two beers. Treatments: two-rescuer helmet removal with in-line stabilization, hard collar, single scoop transfer, all wet clothing cut off and skin dried at 1922, dry blankets, compartment at 30 degrees, hot packs wrapped in towels to the trunk only, oxygen at 15 litres with gentle assisted ventilation, left tib-fib splinted with distal pulses equal to the uninjured side, and gentle handling throughout. No analgesia given - Entonox and methoxyflurane are contraindicated by his altered LOC.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 27 岁男性雪地摩托驾驶者，约 18:00 以约 50 km/h 撞上埋在雪下的树桩，从车头翻出，落在约 8 米外、左侧着地。当时戴着头盔，头盔无破损。他在雪地里躺了约 45 分钟才被同伴发现，而更早时因压破小溪边缘的融雪层，衣服已经湿透。主诉为左小腿痛 7/10、左侧肋骨痛 5/10，并伴意识模糊。我们接手时他已经不再发抖，鼓膜体温 30.5 摄氏度，GCS 13，桡动脉触不到，用 45 秒在颈动脉测得 48 次/分，呼吸 12 次/分且浅表，触诊血压 96/62，皮肤冰冷苍白呈蜡样，SpO2 无法测得，血糖 4.4。目前生命体征：GCS 14、血压 104/68、脉搏 58 且桡动脉已可触及、呼吸 14、15 L 氧下 SpO2 95%、体温 31.4，寒战已重新出现。无既往病史，无用药，无已知过敏，15:00 最后进食并喝了两瓶啤酒。我们的处置：两人配合维持轴线固定摘除头盔，上硬颈托，只做一次铲式担架转移，19:22 剪除全部湿衣物并擦干皮肤，换上干燥毯子，车厢维持 30 摄氏度，加热包用毛巾包好只放躯干，15 L 给氧并轻柔辅助通气，左侧胫腓骨夹板固定且远端脉搏与健侧一致，全程轻柔搬动。未给任何镇痛药——意识改变使 Entonox 和 methoxyflurane 均属禁忌。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Leg and chest pain with confusion after a snowmobile crash and 45 minutes of cold exposure
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Snowmobile versus buried stump at approximately 50 km/h at 1800, thrown over the handlebars, landed left side about 8 m away, helmeted, unwitnessed crash; found 45 minutes later lying in snow, awake but confused; clothing already soaked from a creek edge; leg pain 7/10, rib pain 5/10; two beers at 1500
treatments: Two-rescuer helmet removal with in-line stabilization, hard collar, single scoop transfer onto the spinal device
All wet clothing cut off and skin dried at 1922, dry blankets applied
Active rewarming for moderate hypothermia: compartment at 30 C, hot packs wrapped in towels to trunk only, no packs on limbs, no rubbing or massage
Oxygen 15 L with gentle BVM assisted ventilation, no hyperventilation
Left tib-fib splinted, joints above and below immobilized, distal CSM compared to the uninjured leg before and after
Gentle handling throughout to avoid precipitating ventricular fibrillation
All analgesia withheld - altered LOC contraindicates Entonox and methoxyflurane
findings: Moderate hypothermia: tympanic 30.5 C on arrival, 31.4 C at 30 minutes, shivering absent then returning
Bradycardia 48 with no palpable radial pulse initially, found on a 45 second carotid check
Altered LOC, GCS 13 improving to 14 with rewarming
Closed left mid-shaft tib-fib deformity, distal pulse weak but equal to the uninjured side
Left lateral rib tenderness with equal air entry
White numb fingers and toes suggesting local cold injury, no blistering

scenarios.titleEn: Six-Year-Old Bicycle Crash - Head Injury With Forearm Fracture
scenarios.titleZh: 6 岁儿童自行车事故——头部损伤合并前臂骨折
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1615 hrs. Code 3 to a residential cul-de-sac off Hammond Bay Road in Nanaimo. A six-year-old boy has come off his bicycle and struck his head. His mother is with him and called 911. Dry, overcast, 14 degrees C. Fire first responders are 4 minutes out. Nanaimo Regional General Hospital is 10 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 16:15，Code 3 前往 Nanaimo Hammond Bay 路旁一处住宅区尽头的回车道。一名 6 岁男孩从自行车上摔下并撞到头部。母亲在旁并已拨打 911。天气干燥、多云，气温 14 摄氏度。消防第一响应队还有 4 分钟到达。Nanaimo 地区综合医院距离 10 分钟车程。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the mother saw the whole thing. The boy went over the handlebars at low speed on a driveway slope, was wearing a helmet, and was 'out for a few seconds'. He is awake now, crying, and has vomited once. His left forearm looks bent.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：母亲目击了全过程。男孩在车道斜坡上以较慢的速度从车头翻出，当时戴着头盔，「有几秒钟没有反应」。他现在已经清醒，正在哭，并且吐过一次。他的左前臂看起来是弯的。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan pediatric equipment: pediatric collar or a towel-roll and blocks if no collar fits, padding to keep a small child neutral, arm splints, a length-based tape or weight estimate, and the pediatric drug reference
expected.actionZh: 确认信息并准备儿科装备：儿童颈托（若没有合适尺寸则用毛巾卷加固定块）、用于让幼儿保持中立位的衬垫、上肢夹板、身长体重对照尺或体重估算工具，以及儿科用药参考。

expected.actionEn: Plan the approach to the family as well as the patient: a calm parent is your best assessment tool and an upset parent is your biggest obstacle
expected.actionZh: 不仅要规划对患儿的处置，也要规划如何面对家属：情绪稳定的家长是你最好的评估助手，情绪失控的家长则是最大的阻力。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Quiet cul-de-sac, dry pavement, no traffic - a neighbour has parked across the entrance. The bicycle is on its side at the bottom of a sloped driveway with the front wheel buckled. The boy is sitting on the grass beside the driveway in his mother's lap. His helmet is off, sitting beside him, and it has a visible crack across the left side. Mother is holding him and is tearful but cooperative. One patient. She says: 'Can I just drive him myself? He hates ambulances.'
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：安静的回车道，路面干燥，无车流——一位邻居已把车横停在入口处挡住来车。自行车侧倒在斜坡车道底部，前轮已变形。男孩坐在车道旁的草地上，蜷在母亲怀里。他的头盔已经摘下放在身旁，左侧可见一道明显裂纹。母亲抱着他，在流泪但仍能配合。现场只有一名患者。母亲说：「我能不能自己开车送他去？他最怕救护车了。」

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (driveway slope, the neighbour's vehicle blocking traffic, the bicycle), environment, MOI (over the handlebars at low speed, helmet struck and cracked on the left) and people (one child plus one parent)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（斜坡车道、邻居横停的车辆、倒地的自行车）、环境、受伤机制（低速从车头翻出，头盔左侧受撞并开裂）和人员（一名患儿加一位家长）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves; get down to the child's level, speak to him before you speak about him, and ask the mother's permission to examine him - she gives consent for treatment
expected.actionZh: 戴手套；蹲下与患儿平视，先跟孩子说话再跟大人讨论他的病情，并在检查前征得母亲同意——治疗同意权在她手上。

expected.actionEn: First look: alert crying child, holding his left forearm against his chest, an obvious deformity, no active bleeding, and a cracked helmet as direct evidence that the head took the impact
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：患儿清醒、正在哭，把左前臂护在胸前，前臂有明显畸形，无活动性出血；破裂的头盔是头部受到撞击的直接证据。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR (child, 6 years old): crying, calms if you talk to him gently and let mum hold his hand. He asks 'where is my bike?' three times in two minutes - repetitive questioning. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear, crying loudly with no stridor; respirations 24 and unlaboured with good bilateral air entry; radial pulse 110, strong and regular; capillary refill under 2 seconds; skin warm, dry and pink. RAPID BODY SURVEY: 3 cm boggy hematoma over the left parietal scalp with no depression and no bleeding; he says his neck does not hurt but he cannot stop crying about his arm; chest, abdomen and pelvis unremarkable; obvious closed mid-shaft deformity of the left forearm with a strong radial pulse, normal capillary refill and normal finger movement and sensation; no other injuries. SpO2 98% on room air. Estimated weight 20 kg. He vomited once at scene, before your arrival.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现（6 岁患儿）：在哭，如果你用温和的语气跟他说话、让妈妈牵着他的手，他会平静下来。他在两分钟内问了三次「我的自行车呢？」——这是重复提问。考官（在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，哭声响亮，无喘鸣；呼吸 24 次/分、不费力，双肺呼吸音良好；桡动脉搏动 110 次/分，有力规则；毛细血管再充盈时间小于 2 秒；皮肤温暖、干燥、红润。快速体格检查：左顶部头皮有 3 厘米囊性血肿，无颅骨凹陷、无出血；他说脖子不疼，但一直哭着说手臂痛；胸部、腹部、骨盆均无异常；左前臂中段有明显闭合性畸形，桡动脉搏动有力、毛细血管再充盈正常、手指活动与感觉正常；无其他损伤。室内空气 SpO2 98%。估计体重 20 kg。你到达之前，他在现场吐过一次。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: alert, GCS 15 now, but document the witnessed loss of consciousness and the repetitive questioning as evidence of a brain injury even though he looks well
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：目前清醒、GCS 15；但必须把「目击到的短暂意识丧失」和「重复提问」记录下来，作为脑损伤的证据——哪怕他现在看起来还好。

expected.actionEn: Apply spinal motion restriction: he has an obvious injury above the level of the clavicles, a witnessed LOC and a painful distracting forearm fracture, so his neck cannot be cleared by NEXUS no matter what he says about it
expected.actionZh: 实施脊柱活动限制：他有锁骨以上的明显损伤、被目击的意识丧失，以及一处会分散注意力的疼痛性前臂骨折——无论他自己怎么说，都不能用 NEXUS 排除颈椎损伤。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway; a strong loud cry is a reassuring airway sign in a child
expected.actionZh: 评估气道；儿童能发出响亮有力的哭声本身就是气道通畅的良好指征。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing and interpret the rate against pediatric norms - 24 is normal for a six-year-old, whereas the same rate in an adult would be abnormal
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸，并按儿科正常值解读——6 岁儿童 24 次/分属于正常，而同样的数值在成人身上就不正常了。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation with a radial pulse and capillary refill; know that children compensate for shock by raising the heart rate and hold their blood pressure until they crash suddenly
expected.actionZh: 通过桡动脉搏动和毛细血管再充盈评估循环；要知道儿童靠加快心率来代偿休克，血压往往一直正常，直到突然失代偿。

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey head to toe, explaining each step to the child in words he understands and examining the painful arm last
expected.actionZh: 从头到脚完成快速体格检查，每一步都用孩子听得懂的话先说明，并把最痛的那条手臂留到最后检查。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin as warm, dry and pink with capillary refill under 2 seconds
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：温暖、干燥、红润，毛细血管再充盈时间小于 2 秒。

expected.actionEn: Oxygen: keep SpO2 at or above 94% for any head injury - at 98% on room air supplemental oxygen is not required, and say so rather than applying it out of habit
expected.actionZh: 氧疗：任何颅脑损伤都要把 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上——本例室内空气已达 98%，无需额外给氧；请把这个判断说出来，而不是习惯性地扣上面罩。

expected.actionEn: Position: keep him with his mother, immobilized but comfortable, and elevate the head of the device 30 degrees for the head injury once he is secured
expected.actionZh: 体位：让他和母亲待在一起，既做好固定又保持舒适；固定完成后，因头部损伤将固定装置头端抬高 30 度。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. He has a witnessed LOC, one episode of vomiting and repetitive questioning, but right now he is GCS 15 with normal vital signs, a normal airway and no unstable criteria - this is a NON-RTC transport with a high index of suspicion and continuous monitoring. Say the decision and say the trigger: any drop in GCS, further vomiting, a rising or falling heart rate, or a change in pupils upgrades him to RTC immediately. The mother's request to drive him herself must be handled: explain why he needs spinal precautions and monitoring, offer to have her ride in the ambulance, and do not release the child to a private vehicle.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。他有被目击的意识丧失、呕吐一次和重复提问，但目前 GCS 15、生命体征正常、气道正常，也不符合任何不稳定标准——因此按非 RTC 转运，但要保持高度警惕并持续监测。请说出这个决策，也说出升级条件：GCS 一旦下降、再次呕吐、心率升高或降低、或瞳孔改变，就立即升级为 RTC。母亲提出自己开车送的请求必须处理好：解释为什么需要脊柱防护和途中监测，主动邀请她坐救护车同行，绝不能把孩子交给私家车送走。

expected.actionEn: Correctly categorize as non-RTC with the reasons stated: GCS 15, stable vitals, patent airway, no unstable criteria met
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC 并说明理由：GCS 15、生命体征稳定、气道通畅、不符合任何不稳定标准。

expected.actionEn: State the upgrade triggers: any fall in GCS, repeated vomiting, changing heart rate, unequal pupils or a seizure makes this RTC
expected.actionZh: 说出升级条件：GCS 下降、反复呕吐、心率变化、瞳孔不等大或出现抽搐，任何一条都要升级为 RTC。

expected.actionEn: Manage the parent: explain the need for ambulance transport in plain language, obtain consent, keep her with the child, and do not let the child leave by private vehicle
expected.actionZh: 处理好家长：用通俗的语言解释为什么必须由救护车转运，取得同意，让母亲全程陪在孩子身边，绝不让孩子被私家车带走。

phases.infoEn: MOTHER ANSWERS (the child gives only single words): he was riding down the sloped driveway, the front wheel hit the lip of the gutter, and he went over the handlebars and landed on his left side with his head hitting the pavement. Helmet was on and is cracked on the left. He was limp and unresponsive for 'about five or ten seconds' and then started crying. He vomited once about five minutes later. He keeps asking the same question about his bike. He has not been himself since. CHILD: 'my arm hurts', points to the left forearm, cries when it moves, will not rate the pain in numbers - use a faces scale and he picks the second-worst face. PMHx: born at term, healthy, up to date on immunizations, no previous head injury. Meds: none. Allergies: none known. LOI: a snack of crackers and juice about 1530, 45 minutes before the crash. Weight: mother says he was 20 kg at his last check-up.
phases.infoZh: 母亲回答（患儿只能说单个词）：他骑车下斜坡车道时，前轮撞到路缘石边沿，人从车头翻出，左侧着地、头部撞到路面。当时戴着头盔，头盔左侧已开裂。他软软地没有反应「大概五到十秒」，然后就开始哭。约五分钟后吐了一次。他一直重复问同一个关于自行车的问题。从那以后整个人就不太对劲。患儿：「我的手臂好痛」，指着左前臂，一动就哭，不会用数字评分——改用表情脸谱量表，他指了倒数第二痛的那张脸。既往史：足月出生，身体健康，疫苗接种齐全，无既往头部外伤。用药：无。过敏史：无已知过敏。最后进食：15:30 左右吃了饼干、喝了果汁，距事故 45 分钟。体重：母亲说上次体检时是 20 公斤。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: left forearm pain and a head injury with a witnessed brief loss of consciousness
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：左前臂疼痛，以及伴有被目击短暂意识丧失的头部损伤。

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from the parent covering the fall questions and the head injury specifics: height and speed, what he struck, what hit first, helmet worn and damaged, exact duration of the LOC, number of vomits, seizure activity, and any change in behaviour since
expected.actionZh: 向家长采集现病史，覆盖跌落类必问项和颅脑损伤要点：高度与速度、撞到什么、身体哪个部位先着地、是否戴头盔及头盔是否损坏、意识丧失的确切时长、呕吐次数、有无抽搐，以及事后行为有无变化。

expected.actionEn: Pain score using an age-appropriate tool such as a faces scale rather than asking a six-year-old for a number
expected.actionZh: 使用适合年龄的工具（如表情脸谱量表）做疼痛评分，而不是要求一个 6 岁孩子给出数字。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history including birth history and immunizations
expected.actionZh: 既往病史，包括出生史和疫苗接种情况。

expected.actionEn: Medications, including anything given by the parent before your arrival
expected.actionZh: 用药史，包括家长在你到达之前自行给孩子服用过的任何药物。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake and an accurate weight - both drive pediatric drug dosing and anaesthetic planning
expected.actionZh: 最后进食进饮时间和准确体重——这两项既决定儿科给药剂量，也影响麻醉安排。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (on scene, with a pediatric cuff on the uninjured arm): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 104/64; pulse 110 strong and regular; respirations 24 unlaboured; skin warm dry pink, capillary refill under 2 seconds; pupils equal and briskly reactive; SpO2 98% on room air; BGL 5.1 mmol/L (justified by the reported LOC); temperature 36.9 C. Compare against pediatric norms for a six-year-old: heart rate roughly 75-120, respirations roughly 18-25, systolic roughly 95-110 - all of his numbers are normal for his age.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（现场，用儿童袖带在未受伤的手臂上测量）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 104/64；脉搏 110 次/分，有力规则；呼吸 24 次/分、不费力；皮肤温暖干燥红润，毛细血管再充盈小于 2 秒；瞳孔等大、对光反应灵敏；室内空气 SpO2 98%；血糖 5.1 mmol/L（因有意识丧失史而有测量指征）；体温 36.9 摄氏度。与 6 岁儿童的正常值对照：心率约 75–120 次/分、呼吸约 18–25 次/分、收缩压约 95–110 mmHg——他的各项数值按年龄都属正常。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components, using age-appropriate expectations for the verbal score
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分并分别说出三项分值，语言项要按年龄相应的标准来判断。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure with a correctly sized pediatric cuff on the uninjured arm, interpreted against pediatric norms
expected.actionZh: 在未受伤的手臂上使用尺寸正确的儿童袖带测血压，并按儿科正常值解读结果。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality, interpreted against pediatric norms - and remember bradycardia in a head-injured child is a late and ominous sign
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱，并按儿科正常值解读——同时记住：颅脑损伤患儿出现心动过缓是晚期的危险信号。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character against pediatric norms
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质，并按儿科正常值解读。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on with capillary refill, which is more useful than blood pressure in a child
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤并测毛细血管再充盈——在儿童身上，这一项比血压更有参考价值。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - the single most important repeated observation in a head-injured child
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——这是颅脑损伤患儿最需要反复观察的一项。

expected.actionEn: SpO2, targeting 94% or above for the head injury
expected.actionZh: SpO2，颅脑损伤的目标是维持在 94% 及以上。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - indicated by the reported loss of consciousness
expected.actionZh: 血糖——因有意识丧失史而有测量指征。

expected.actionEn: Temperature
expected.actionZh: 体温。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, taken mostly from the mother. General - normally a healthy active child, eating and drinking well, no recent illness; CNS - brief LOC, repetitive questioning, complains of a headache when asked, no seizure, no weakness, no numbness; respiratory - no cough or breathing complaint; cardiovascular - nil; GI/GU - one vomit, no abdominal pain, passed urine normally this afternoon; integumentary - scalp hematoma and a grazed left knee; musculoskeletal - left forearm; endocrine - nil; EENT - no bleeding from the nose or ears, mother thinks his eyes 'look normal', he says lights are too bright.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，主要由母亲代述。全身健康——平时是个健康好动的孩子，吃喝正常，近期无疾病；中枢神经——短暂意识丧失、重复提问，被问到时说头痛，无抽搐、无肢体无力、无麻木；呼吸——无咳嗽及呼吸不适；心血管——无异常；消化/泌尿——呕吐一次，无腹痛，今天下午排尿正常；皮肤——头皮血肿和左膝擦伤；肌肉骨骼——左前臂；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——鼻和耳道无出血，母亲觉得他的眼睛「看起来正常」，但他自己说光太刺眼。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (headache, photophobia and repetitive questioning are the concussion cluster)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（头痛、畏光和重复提问构成典型的脑震荡症状群）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (the number of vomits matters in a head injury)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统（颅脑损伤时呕吐的次数具有重要意义）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (photophobia, and checking ears and nose for blood or fluid)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉（畏光，并检查耳鼻有无血液或液体流出）。

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe, done with the mother beside him: head/neck - 3 cm boggy hematoma left parietal, no depression, no bruising behind the ears, no blood or fluid from ears or nose, no midline cervical tenderness but he is distracted by the arm; chest - no tenderness, equal air entry, no seat-belt or handlebar mark; abdomen - soft and non-tender, specifically no handlebar bruise over the epigastrium; back - checked when he is moved onto the device, no tenderness; upper extremities - obvious closed mid-shaft deformity of the left forearm with the skin intact, radial pulse strong, capillary refill under 2 seconds, he can wiggle his fingers and feels you touch them; lower extremities - grazed left knee, otherwise normal with normal CSM.
phases.infoZh: 在母亲陪同下完成从头到脚检查：头颈——左顶部 3 厘米囊性血肿，无颅骨凹陷，耳后无瘀斑，耳鼻无血液或液体流出，颈椎中线无压痛但他的注意力全在手臂上；胸部——无压痛，双肺呼吸音对称，无安全带或车把撞击痕迹；腹部——柔软无压痛，特别确认上腹部没有车把造成的瘀伤；背部——在移上固定装置时检查，无压痛；上肢——左前臂中段明显闭合性畸形，皮肤完整，桡动脉搏动有力，毛细血管再充盈小于 2 秒，手指能活动且能感觉到你的触碰；下肢——左膝擦伤，其余正常，CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined including behind the ears and the ear canals, before the collar is applied
expected.actionZh: 在上颈托之前完成头颈检查，包括查看耳后和外耳道。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with six-site auscultation and inspected for a handlebar mark
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查：6 个位置听诊，并查看有无车把撞击痕迹。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined specifically for handlebar injury - a classic and easily missed pediatric bicycle injury
expected.actionZh: 腹部检查要专门排查车把撞击伤——这是儿童自行车事故中经典且极易漏诊的损伤。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the transfer onto the device
expected.actionZh: 在把患儿移上固定装置时检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with CSM above and below the deformity documented before and after splinting
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查：在畸形部位上下方查 CSM，并在上夹板前后各记录一次。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with CSM
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查，并记录 CSM。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE, adapted for a child. SPINAL: manual stabilization in a neutral position - a small child's head is proportionally large, so pad UNDER THE SHOULDERS to stop the neck flexing forward; use a correctly sized pediatric collar or, if none fits, manual stabilization with rolled towels and blocks; secure the body to the device and never tape the head. HEAD INJURY: keep SpO2 at or above 94%, elevate the head of the device 30 degrees, keep the collar loose enough not to obstruct venous drainage, and reassess GCS and pupils every 5 minutes. FRACTURE: splint the forearm in the position found with the joints above and below immobilized, check CSM before and after, apply cold, and elevate on a pillow. ANALGESIA - THIS IS THE PEDIATRIC TRAP: methoxyflurane is contraindicated under 18 years; Entonox requires the patient to self-administer and comply, which a distressed six-year-old realistically cannot do, and it is also cautioned with an altered LOC; acetaminophen has NO pediatric dose in the BC monograph, so an adult 500-1,000 mg dose given to a 20 kg child is a dosing error; ibuprofen DOES have weight-based pediatric dosing at 10 mg/kg PO, which is 200 mg for this 20 kg boy, and it may be repeated once after 6 hours. Give it only if he is fully alert and has not vomited again, and document the decision either way. Non-drug analgesia is the mainstay: splint well, apply cold, keep mum holding his hand, and distract him. OUT OF EMR SCOPE: IV access, ondansetron for the vomiting, dimenhydrinate, and any IV analgesia.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围内的处置，但要按儿科调整。脊柱：以中立位徒手固定——幼儿头部相对身体偏大，因此必须在肩背下方加垫，防止颈部前屈；使用尺寸正确的儿童颈托，若没有合适尺寸，则用毛巾卷加固定块并保持徒手固定；把躯干固定在装置上，绝不可用胶带缠头。颅脑损伤：把 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上；把固定装置头端抬高 30 度；颈托不要勒得过紧以免阻碍静脉回流；每 5 分钟复评一次 GCS 和瞳孔。骨折：在原位给前臂上夹板并固定住上下两个关节，上夹板前后各查一次 CSM，局部冷敷，并用枕头抬高患肢。镇痛——这就是本例的儿科陷阱：methoxyflurane 未满 18 岁禁用；Entonox 必须由患者自行吸入并能配合，一个哭闹的 6 岁孩子现实中做不到，而且意识改变时本身也属慎用；acetaminophen 在 BC 药物专论中没有儿科剂量，把成人的 500–1,000 mg 用在 20 公斤的孩子身上就是剂量错误；ibuprofen 则有明确的按体重儿科剂量：10 mg/kg 口服，本例 20 公斤即 200 mg，6 小时后可重复一次。只有在他完全清醒、没有再次呕吐的前提下才给，无论给还是不给都要写清理由。非药物镇痛才是主力：夹板固定到位、局部冷敷、让妈妈一直牵着他的手、用聊天和玩具分散注意力。超出 EMR 范围：静脉通路、用于止吐的 ondansetron、dimenhydrinate，以及任何静脉镇痛药。

expected.actionEn: Pediatric spinal immobilization done correctly: neutral position with padding UNDER THE SHOULDERS, correctly sized collar or manual stabilization with towel rolls, body secured, head never taped
expected.actionZh: 正确完成儿科脊柱固定：保持中立位并在肩背下方加垫，使用尺寸正确的颈托或用毛巾卷维持徒手固定，躯干固定牢靠，绝不用胶带缠头。

expected.actionEn: Splint the left forearm in the position found, immobilizing the joints above and below, with CSM checked and documented before and after, plus cold and elevation
expected.actionZh: 在原位给左前臂上夹板，固定住上下两个关节，上夹板前后各检查并记录一次 CSM，同时局部冷敷并抬高患肢。

expected.actionEn: Head injury management: SpO2 kept at or above 94%, head of the device elevated 30 degrees, the collar kept loose, and GCS and pupils reassessed every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 颅脑损伤处置：SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上，固定装置头端抬高 30 度，颈托保持宽松，每 5 分钟复评 GCS 和瞳孔。

expected.actionEn: If analgesia is given, use weight-based ibuprofen 10 mg/kg PO - 200 mg for a 20 kg child - and never an adult dose; state the weight you used and how you obtained it
expected.actionZh: 若要给镇痛药，必须用按体重计算的 ibuprofen 10 mg/kg 口服——20 公斤患儿即 200 mg——绝不可用成人剂量；并说明你使用的体重数值及其来源。

expected.actionEn: Rule out and verbalize the pediatric analgesia restrictions: methoxyflurane is contraindicated under 18, and Entonox requires self-administration and cooperation this child cannot reliably give
expected.actionZh: 逐条排除并口头说明儿科镇痛的限制：methoxyflurane 未满 18 岁禁用；Entonox 必须患者自行吸入并配合，而这个孩子做不到可靠配合。

expected.actionEn: Family-centred care: keep the mother with the child throughout, explain each step in words the child understands, obtain parental consent, and refuse the private-vehicle transport politely but firmly
expected.actionZh: 以家庭为中心的照护：全程让母亲陪在孩子身边，用孩子听得懂的话解释每一步，取得家长同意，并礼貌而坚定地拒绝让家属自行开车送医。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, GCS, pupils and the splinted arm every 5 minutes even though he looks well - a child with a head injury can deteriorate quickly and late. Set 2 (in the ambulance, 15 minutes after set 1, after splinting and cold): GCS 15; BP 102/62; pulse 104; respirations 22; skin warm dry pink; pupils equal and briskly reactive; SpO2 98% on room air; he has not vomited again, is calmer, and is no longer asking the repeated question. Faces-scale pain has dropped from the second-worst face to the middle face after splinting.
phases.infoZh: 尽管他看上去还好，仍要每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC、GCS、瞳孔和已固定的手臂——颅脑损伤的儿童可能既快又晚地突然恶化。第 2 组（车上，第 1 组之后 15 分钟，已上夹板并冷敷）：GCS 15；血压 102/62；脉搏 104 次/分；呼吸 22 次/分；皮肤温暖干燥红润；瞳孔等大、对光反应灵敏；室内空气 SpO2 98%；未再呕吐，情绪较前平静，也不再重复问那个问题了。上夹板后，表情脸谱疼痛评分已从倒数第二痛的脸降到中间那张脸。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after every move and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和已实施的处置。

expected.actionEn: Serial GCS and pupil checks documented with times - the trend is what the receiving team needs
expected.actionZh: 连续复查 GCS 和瞳孔并逐次记录时间——接收团队真正需要的是这条变化趋势。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 17-18 minutes for a non-priority patient
expected.actionZh: 非优先患者，第二组完整生命体征应在 17–18 分钟内完成。

expected.actionEn: Recheck CSM distal to the forearm splint after every move and re-score the pain with the faces scale
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动后都重新检查前臂夹板远端的 CSM，并用表情脸谱量表重新评分疼痛。

expected.actionEn: Keep suction ready in case he vomits again while immobilized, and be ready to tip the whole device
expected.actionZh: 备好吸引器以防他在固定状态下再次呕吐，并做好整块固定装置一起侧倾的准备。

phases.infoEn: Non-priority patient, but the head injury details must be handed over precisely. Hand-off must state the exact duration of the witnessed LOC, the number of vomits, the repetitive questioning, the cracked helmet, and any analgesia with the weight-based dose used. PCR within 5 minutes, including the parent's name and the consent obtained.
phases.infoZh: 属非优先患者，但颅脑损伤的细节必须交接得非常精确。交接时必须说明：被目击的意识丧失确切持续时间、呕吐次数、重复提问的表现、头盔开裂情况，以及是否给过镇痛药及所用的按体重剂量。5 分钟内完成 PCR，并写明家长姓名和已取得同意这一事实。

expected.actionEn: Notification appropriate to a stable pediatric head injury
expected.actionZh: 按稳定的儿科颅脑损伤做适当通报。

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with the LOC duration, vomit count, serial GCS and pupils, and the exact ibuprofen dose in mg/kg if given
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：意识丧失时长、呕吐次数、历次 GCS 和瞳孔，以及若给了 ibuprofen 则报出精确的 mg/kg 剂量。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes, documenting the weight used for dosing and the parental consent
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，记录用于计算剂量的体重数值以及家长同意的情况。
