criticalPitfallsEn: Not immobilizing the spine because the child says his neck does not hurt - a scalp hematoma is an obvious injury above the clavicles, and a painful forearm fracture is a distracting injury, so NEXUS cannot clear him; failing to initiate C-spine control when indicated is a 100% deduction
Giving an adult acetaminophen dose to a 20 kg child - the BC monograph carries no pediatric acetaminophen dose, and the weight-based pediatric option is ibuprofen 10 mg/kg PO, here 200 mg
Offering Entonox to a distressed six-year-old who cannot reliably self-administer, or offering methoxyflurane, which is contraindicated under 18 years
Immobilizing a small child flat with no padding under the shoulders, which forces the neck into flexion because of the proportionally large head
Letting the mother drive him to hospital herself, or leaving her behind - both harm the child and the assessment
Missing the handlebar mechanism: not examining the abdomen for a handlebar injury, which is the classic occult pediatric bicycle injury
Failing to reassess GCS and pupils serially because he 'looks fine' - if the GCS falls this immediately becomes an RTC call
criticalPitfallsZh: 因为孩子说「脖子不疼」就不做脊柱固定——头皮血肿属于锁骨以上的明显损伤，疼痛的前臂骨折又是分散注意力的损伤，NEXUS 无法排除颈椎损伤；有指征时未启动 C-spine 控制扣 100%。
给 20 公斤的孩子用成人剂量的 acetaminophen——BC 药物专论里 acetaminophen 根本没有儿科剂量，可按体重给药的儿科选择是 ibuprofen 10 mg/kg 口服，本例为 200 mg。
给一个哭闹、无法可靠自行吸入的 6 岁孩子用 Entonox，或者给未满 18 岁禁用的 methoxyflurane。
把幼儿平平地固定住却不在肩背下方加垫——幼儿头部相对偏大，这样会把颈部压成前屈位。
让母亲自己开车把孩子送去医院，或者把她留在现场——这两种做法既伤害孩子也破坏评估。
漏掉车把这一受伤机制：没有专门检查腹部有无车把撞击伤，而这正是儿童自行车事故中最典型的隐匿损伤。
因为「看起来没事」就不连续复评 GCS 和瞳孔——一旦 GCS 下降，这一场立刻就变成 RTC。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: Everything this child needs is EMR scope: neutral-position spinal immobilization with padding under the shoulders, a correctly sized collar, head of the device elevated 30 degrees, SpO2 kept at or above 94%, a well-applied forearm splint with cold and elevation and CSM checks, suction ready in case he vomits again, and serial GCS and pupil checks every 5 minutes. The graded judgement is the drug decision: methoxyflurane is barred under 18, Entonox needs a cooperative self-administering patient, acetaminophen has no pediatric dose in the BC monograph, and the only weight-based option is ibuprofen 10 mg/kg PO - 200 mg for 20 kg. Non-drug analgesia plus a parent at the bedside does most of the work. IV access and antiemetics are out of scope.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这个孩子需要的一切都在 EMR 范围内：中立位脊柱固定并在肩背下方加垫、使用尺寸正确的颈托、固定装置头端抬高 30 度、把 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上、给前臂上好夹板并配合冷敷、抬高和 CSM 检查、备好吸引器以防再次呕吐，以及每 5 分钟连续复评 GCS 和瞳孔。真正拿分的判断在用药上：未满 18 岁禁用 methoxyflurane；Entonox 需要患者能配合并自行吸入；acetaminophen 在 BC 药物专论中没有儿科剂量；唯一能按体重给的是 ibuprofen 10 mg/kg 口服——20 公斤即 200 mg。真正起作用的主要是非药物镇痛加上家长的陪伴。静脉通路和止吐药超出 EMR 范围。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry, and may give ondansetron for further vomiting at the pediatric dose of 0.5 mg/kg with oral preferred, to a maximum of 16 mg - 10 mg for this 20 kg child. PCP would also consider vascular access if the LOC deteriorates, maintain a normal blood glucose between 4.0 and 8.0 mmol/L and support blood pressure for the head injury, and would remember that TXA is contraindicated in isolated traumatic brain injury.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加 9 系统功能问诊；若继续呕吐可给 ondansetron，儿科剂量 0.5 mg/kg（优先口服），上限 16 mg——本例 20 公斤患儿为 10 mg。若意识水平恶化，PCP 还会考虑建立静脉通路，并按颅脑损伤要求把血糖维持在 4.0–8.0 mmol/L、维持足够血压；同时要记住：孤立性颅脑损伤禁用 TXA。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a six-year-old boy, weight approximately 20 kilograms per his mother, who went over the handlebars of his bicycle at low speed on a sloped driveway at 1610, landing on his left side with his head striking the pavement. He was wearing a helmet, which is cracked on the left side. His mother witnessed a loss of consciousness lasting five to ten seconds, and he vomited once about five minutes later. He has been asking the same question repeatedly since. Chief complaint is left forearm pain, second-worst face on the faces scale, improved to the middle face after splinting. Our findings are a 3 centimetre boggy left parietal hematoma with no depression, no blood or fluid from the ears or nose, a closed mid-shaft left forearm deformity with intact distal circulation sensation and movement, and a grazed left knee. There is no handlebar mark on the abdomen and the abdomen is soft. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 104/64, pulse 110, resps 24, SpO2 98% room air, BGL 5.1, temperature 36.9. Latest vitals GCS 15, BP 102/62, pulse 104, resps 22, pupils equal and brisk throughout, and he has not vomited again. Healthy child, no medications, no known allergies, last ate crackers and juice at 1530. Treatments: manual in-line stabilization with padding under the shoulders to keep him neutral, a pediatric collar, secured to the device with the head of the device elevated 30 degrees, forearm splinted with cold and elevation and CSM intact before and after, ibuprofen 200 milligrams by mouth which is 10 milligrams per kilogram at 1638, and his mother has been with him throughout and has consented to treatment and transport.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 6 岁男孩，母亲称体重约 20 公斤。16:10 在斜坡车道上低速骑行时从车头翻出，左侧着地、头部撞击路面。当时戴着头盔，头盔左侧已开裂。母亲目击到持续五到十秒的意识丧失，约五分钟后呕吐一次，此后一直重复问同一个问题。主诉为左前臂疼痛，表情脸谱量表最初指的是倒数第二痛的脸，上夹板后降至中间那张脸。我们的发现：左顶部 3 厘米囊性血肿，无颅骨凹陷，耳鼻无血液或液体流出；左前臂中段闭合性畸形，远端循环、感觉、运动均完好；左膝擦伤。腹部柔软，未见车把撞击痕迹。首组生命体征：GCS 15、血压 104/64、脉搏 110、呼吸 24、室内空气 SpO2 98%、血糖 5.1、体温 36.9。最新一组：GCS 15、血压 102/62、脉搏 104、呼吸 22，全程瞳孔等大、对光反应灵敏，未再呕吐。平素健康，无用药，无已知过敏，15:30 最后进食饼干和果汁。我们的处置：徒手轴线固定并在肩背下方加垫以保持中立位，上儿童颈托，固定于装置上并将头端抬高 30 度；前臂夹板固定并配合冷敷和抬高，上夹板前后 CSM 均完好；16:38 口服 ibuprofen 200 mg（即 10 mg/kg）。母亲全程陪同，并已就治疗和转运表示同意。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Left forearm pain and head injury after a bicycle crash with a witnessed brief loss of consciousness
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Over the handlebars at low speed on a sloped driveway at 1610, front wheel struck the gutter lip, landed left side with head striking pavement, helmet worn and cracked on the left; witnessed LOC 5-10 seconds, one vomit at 5 minutes, repetitive questioning since; forearm pain second-worst face improving to middle face after splinting
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Term birth, healthy, immunizations up to date, no previous head injury
treatments: Manual in-line stabilization with padding UNDER THE SHOULDERS for neutral pediatric positioning
Correctly sized pediatric collar, body secured to the device, head not taped
Head of the device elevated 30 degrees, collar kept loose, SpO2 maintained at or above 94%
Left forearm splinted in the position found, joints above and below immobilized, cold applied, limb elevated, CSM intact before and after
Ibuprofen 200 mg PO (10 mg/kg for 20 kg) at 1638; acetaminophen not given - no pediatric dose in the BC monograph
Entonox and methoxyflurane withheld - unable to reliably self-administer, and methoxyflurane contraindicated under 18
Suction kept ready for further vomiting; mother present throughout, consent obtained, private-vehicle transport declined
findings: Witnessed LOC 5-10 seconds, one vomit, repetitive questioning - GCS 15 throughout with equal brisk pupils
3 cm boggy left parietal hematoma, no depression, no blood or fluid from ears or nose
Cracked helmet as evidence of the impact
Closed mid-shaft left forearm deformity, distal CSM intact at every check
Abdomen soft with no handlebar mark
All vital signs within pediatric norms for a six-year-old at both sets

scenarios.titleEn: Industrial Roller Crush - De-gloved Forearm, Tourniquet and an Amputated Finger
scenarios.titleZh: 工业滚轮挤压伤——前臂脱套、止血带使用与离断手指的保存
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0640 hrs. Code 3 to a metal fabrication shop on Kingsway Avenue in Port Coquitlam. A worker's right arm has been caught in a powered roller. Coworkers have freed him and the machine has been locked out; the supervisor has notified WorkSafeBC. Fire is on scene and confirms the lockout. Dark, clear, 4 degrees C. Royal Columbian Hospital is 15 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 06:40，Code 3 前往 Port Coquitlam 京士威大道一家金属加工厂。一名工人的右臂被动力滚轮卷入。工友已把他解救出来，机器已上锁断电；主管已通报 WorkSafeBC。消防已到场并确认机器已锁定。天黑、晴，气温 4 摄氏度。Royal Columbian 医院距离 15 分钟车程。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: fire reports heavy bleeding that direct pressure is not holding, the patient is conscious, and a coworker has found a finger in the machine. Fire asks whether they should keep pressure on or apply their tourniquet.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：消防报告出血很凶、直接压迫压不住，患者神志清楚，另有一名工友在机器里找到了一根手指。消防询问：他们是继续压迫，还是先上止血带。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and prepare the hemorrhage kit before you walk in: trauma dressings, gauze for packing, a commercial tourniquet, a marker for the time, and a container and sterile saline for the amputated part
expected.actionZh: 确认信息，并在进门之前就把止血装备准备好：创伤敷料、用于填塞的纱布、成品止血带、用于记录时间的记号笔，以及保存离断肢体用的容器和无菌生理盐水。

expected.actionEn: Direct fire over the radio to maintain firm direct pressure while you are en route, and confirm the machine is locked out before anyone approaches
expected.actionZh: 在途中就通过无线电指导消防维持有力的直接压迫，并在任何人靠近之前确认机器确实已锁定断电。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Shop floor, good overhead lighting, machine stopped with a lockout tag visible on the panel and a firefighter standing by it. Oil on the concrete near the machine. The patient is sitting on the floor with his back against a pallet, supported by a coworker who is pressing a shop rag onto his forearm. There is a pool of blood on the floor roughly 30 centimetres across and blood is dripping steadily through the rag. One patient. A coworker holds up a clear plastic bag: 'I found his ring finger in the roller.' Air temperature in the shop is 12 degrees C with the bay door open.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：车间地面，顶灯照明良好，机器已停机，控制面板上可见挂锁标签，一名消防员在旁看守。机器附近的混凝土地面上有油污。患者靠着一个托盘坐在地上，一名工友扶着他，并用车间抹布压在他的前臂上。地面有一摊直径约 30 厘米的血泊，血正不断从抹布里渗出滴落。现场只有一名患者。一名工友举着一个透明塑料袋说：「我在滚轮里找到了他的无名指。」卷帘门开着，车间温度 12 摄氏度。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (powered machinery - confirm the lockout with fire before approaching, oil on the floor, blood exposure), environment, MOI (right forearm drawn into a powered roller) and people (one patient plus witnesses)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（动力机械——靠近前先与消防确认已锁定断电、地面油污、血液暴露）、环境、受伤机制（右前臂被卷入动力滚轮）和人员（一名患者外加目击工友）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves, eye protection and a gown or sleeve protection - this is a high-volume blood exposure, and double gloving is reasonable
expected.actionZh: 戴手套、护目镜，并穿隔离衣或袖套——这是大量血液暴露的场面，戴双层手套是合理的。

expected.actionEn: First look: alert adult male, pale and sweating, a large blood pool, steady bleeding through a soaked rag, right forearm grossly deformed with tissue loss
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：成年男性神志清醒，面色苍白、出汗，地面有大片血泊，血不断从浸透的抹布中渗出，右前臂明显畸形并有组织缺损。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and oriented but frightened, breathing fast, says 'don't let me lose my arm'. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear, speaking full sentences; respirations 24 and unlaboured with equal air entry; LEFT radial pulse 124, weak and regular; skin pale, cool and clammy. RAPID BODY SURVEY: no head, neck, chest, abdominal or pelvic injury and no other trauma - the machine caught the arm only; RIGHT FOREARM is de-gloved from mid-forearm to the wrist with exposed muscle, a grossly deformed mid-shaft, and steady arterial bleeding; the right hand is cold and mottled with NO radial pulse; the right ring finger is amputated at the middle joint and is in the coworker's bag. Estimated blood loss on the floor is 700 to 800 mL. SpO2 93% on room air. HEMORRHAGE SEQUENCE - give in this order as the candidate works: direct pressure with a trauma dressing slows but does not stop it; a pressure dressing over the top still soaks through in under a minute; only a tourniquet applied proximal to the wound stops the bleeding completely. UNSTABLE: hemorrhage requiring a tourniquet, a crushed and de-gloved extremity, a pulseless extremity, and shock.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：神志清醒、定向力正常但很恐惧，呼吸急促，反复说「别让我把手臂锯掉」。考官（在考生实际评估时给出）：气道通畅，能说完整句子；呼吸 24 次/分、不费力，双肺呼吸音对称；左侧桡动脉搏动 124 次/分、细弱规则；皮肤苍白、发凉、湿黏。快速体格检查：头、颈、胸、腹、骨盆均无损伤，也无其他外伤——机器只卷住了手臂；右前臂自中段至腕部呈脱套伤，肌肉外露，中段明显畸形，持续动脉性出血；右手冰冷、花斑，桡动脉搏动消失；右手无名指自中节关节处离断，现在工友的袋子里。地面失血量估计 700 至 800 mL。室内空气 SpO2 93%。出血控制的分级脚本——按考生的操作依次给出：用创伤敷料直接压迫可以减慢但止不住；再加压力绷带，一分钟内仍会被浸透；只有在伤口近心端上止血带才能完全止住出血。不稳定判定：需要止血带的大出血、挤压脱套的肢体、无脉的肢体，以及休克。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: alert and oriented
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：清醒、定向力正常。

expected.actionEn: Apply NEXUS and state that spinal motion restriction is not indicated: an isolated machine entrapment of the forearm with no fall, no head strike and a normal neurological exam
expected.actionZh: 套用 NEXUS 标准并说明无需脊柱固定：这是孤立的前臂机器卷入伤，没有跌落、没有头部撞击，神经系统检查也正常。

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway - patent, speaking clearly
expected.actionZh: 评估气道——通畅，说话清晰。

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing with auscultation; a rate of 24 in a bleeding patient is a shock sign, not a lung problem
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸并听诊；出血患者呼吸 24 次/分是休克的表现，而不是肺部本身的问题。

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation on the UNINJURED arm and recognize a weak pulse of 124 with pale cool clammy skin and 700-800 mL on the floor as haemorrhagic shock
expected.actionZh: 在未受伤的一侧手臂评估循环，并把 124 次/分的细弱脉搏、苍白湿冷的皮肤和地面 700–800 mL 的失血解读为失血性休克。

expected.actionEn: CONTROL THE HEMORRHAGE IN THE PRIMARY SURVEY, escalating in the correct order: direct pressure, then a pressure dressing, then a tourniquet proximal to the wound when the first two fail
expected.actionZh: 在初级评估阶段就控制出血，并按正确顺序逐级升级：先直接压迫，再加压力绷带，前两步无效时立即在伤口近心端上止血带。

expected.actionEn: Complete the rest of the rapid body survey rather than tunnel-visioning on the dramatic arm injury - confirm there is no head, chest, abdominal or pelvic injury
expected.actionZh: 在处理完出血后仍要完成其余的快速体格检查，不要被触目惊心的手臂伤吸住全部注意力——必须确认头、胸、腹、骨盆没有损伤。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin as pale, cool and clammy
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、发凉、湿黏。

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L via non-rebreather for shock and SpO2 93%
expected.actionZh: 因休克且 SpO2 93%，用非重复呼吸面罩给 15 L 高流量氧。

expected.actionEn: Position supine on the stretcher for hypotension and cover with blankets - he is bleeding in a 12 degree shop with the bay door open
expected.actionZh: 因低血压将其仰卧于担架床上并加盖毯子——他正在一个开着卷帘门、只有 12 摄氏度的车间里失血。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Hemorrhage requiring a tourniquet, a crushed and de-gloved extremity, a pulseless extremity and shock are four separate unstable criteria - this is Rapid Transport Category. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Destination is the trauma centre; a de-gloved forearm with an amputated digit needs a replantation-capable facility, so say the destination decision out loud.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。需要止血带的大出血、挤压脱套的肢体、无脉的肢体、休克——这是四条各自独立的不稳定标准，因此判为 RTC。15 分钟内完成装载准备。目的地是创伤中心：前臂脱套伤合并手指离断需要有断肢再植能力的医院，所以请把目的地决策明确说出来。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and name the criteria met
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC，并逐条说出所符合的标准。

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes - dress the wound well enough to transport, not perfectly
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内完成装载准备——伤口包扎到「能转运」即可，不必追求完美。

expected.actionEn: State the destination decision and notify early that this is a mangled extremity with an amputated digit
expected.actionZh: 说出目的地决策，并尽早预报这是一例合并手指离断的严重毁损肢体伤。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS (alert, frightened, wants to talk about the machine): he was clearing a jam on the roller at 0630 when his glove caught and pulled his right hand and forearm in; a coworker hit the emergency stop within a few seconds and it took them another two or three minutes to free him. He did not fall and did not hit his head. Pain is in the right forearm and hand, 10/10, described as burning and crushing, constant, nothing relieves it. PMHx: healthy, no surgeries. Meds: none. Allergies: none known. LOI: coffee at 0600, no food since dinner last night.
phases.infoZh: 演员回答（神志清醒、恐惧，一直想说机器的事）：06:30 他在清理滚轮卡料时手套被卷住，把右手连同前臂一起拖了进去；一名工友在几秒钟内拍下了急停按钮，之后又花了两三分钟才把他解救出来。他没有跌倒，也没有撞到头。疼痛位于右前臂和右手，10/10，性质为灼烧样和挤压样，持续不缓解，什么都不管用。既往史：身体健康，无手术史。用药：无。过敏史：无已知过敏。最后进食：06:00 喝了咖啡，昨晚晚饭后没再吃东西。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: right forearm crush and de-gloving injury with uncontrolled bleeding
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：右前臂挤压合并脱套伤，出血难以控制。

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST plus the machine-injury specifics: what machine, was it powered when it caught him, how long was he entrapped, was the arm pulled or crushed, was there any traction on the shoulder, and the time the injury occurred - the clock matters for replantation
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST 采集现病史，并补齐机械伤的关键细节：什么机器、卷入时是否仍在运转、被卡住多长时间、手臂是被拉拽还是被碾压、肩部是否受到牵拉，以及受伤的准确时间——因为再植是跟时间赛跑的。

expected.actionEn: Pain score, and re-score it after the tourniquet, which itself is painful
expected.actionZh: 做疼痛评分，并在上止血带之后再评一次——止血带本身就会带来剧痛。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history
expected.actionZh: 既往病史。

expected.actionEn: Medications, particularly anticoagulants or antiplatelets
expected.actionZh: 用药史，尤其是抗凝药和抗血小板药。

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake - he is going straight to the operating room
expected.actionZh: 最后进食进饮——他将直接进手术室。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (taken on the UNINJURED left arm, in the ambulance): GCS 15 (E4 V5 M6); BP 88/58; pulse 124 weak and regular; respirations 24 unlaboured; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal and reactive; SpO2 93% on room air rising to 97% on 15 L; BGL not routinely indicated but reasonable at 5.8 mmol/L; temperature 36.2 C. Do not put a cuff or a probe on the injured limb.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（在未受伤的左臂上测量，车内完成）：GCS 15（E4 V5 M6）；血压 88/58；脉搏 124 次/分、细弱规则；呼吸 24 次/分、不费力；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 93%，给 15 L 氧后升至 97%；血糖并非常规必测，但测得 5.8 mmol/L 也合理；体温 36.2 摄氏度。切勿把袖带或血氧探头装在受伤的那条手臂上。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分，并分别说出三项分值。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure on the uninjured arm; recognize a systolic of 88 as decompensated haemorrhagic shock
expected.actionZh: 在未受伤的手臂上测血压；把收缩压 88 判读为失代偿性失血性休克。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality on the uninjured side
expected.actionZh: 在健侧测脉搏的频率、节律和强弱。

expected.actionEn: Respiratory rate, depth and character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸的频率、深度和性质。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤。

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with the probe on the uninjured hand
expected.actionZh: 把血氧探头夹在未受伤的那只手上测 SpO2。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose
expected.actionZh: 血糖。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - a bleeding patient in a cold shop loses heat fast and cold blood clots poorly
expected.actionZh: 体温——在寒冷车间里出血的患者散热极快，而低温的血液凝固能力很差。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, brief because he is a priority patient. ACTOR: general - fit, works the early shift, no illness; CNS - no LOC, no head strike, feels light-headed when he sits up; respiratory - no complaint; cardiovascular - heart racing; GI/GU - nauseated, no vomiting; integumentary - the forearm wound, no other wounds; musculoskeletal - right arm only, shoulder feels sore from being pulled; endocrine - nil; EENT - vision greyed out briefly when the coworkers sat him up.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要，因属优先患者须从简。演员回答：全身健康——身体健康，上早班，无疾病；中枢神经——无意识丧失、无头部撞击，坐起来时感觉头晕；呼吸——无不适；心血管——心跳很快；消化/泌尿——恶心，无呕吐；皮肤——只有前臂那处伤口，别处无伤；肌肉骨骼——只有右上肢，肩部因被拉拽而酸痛；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——工友把他扶坐起来时曾短暂眼前发黑。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (light-headedness on sitting up is postural hypotension from blood loss)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统（坐起时头晕，是失血导致的体位性低血压）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal (traction on the shoulder can injure the brachial plexus)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统（肩部被牵拉可能造成臂丛神经损伤）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (transient greying of vision is another shock sign)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉（短暂的眼前发黑是又一个休克征象）。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe, kept focused: head/neck - no injury, no midline tenderness; chest - no tenderness, equal air entry at all six sites; abdomen - soft and non-tender; back - inspected, no injury; RIGHT upper extremity - tourniquet in place high on the upper arm with the time written on it, bleeding stopped, the forearm dressed with bulky sterile dressings, the hand distal to the tourniquet is cold and pale with no pulse as expected, the ring finger stump is dressed, the shoulder moves without deformity; LEFT upper extremity - normal with intact CSM; lower extremities - normal with intact CSM bilaterally.
phases.infoZh: 途中的从头到脚检查，保持重点突出：头颈——无损伤，中线无压痛；胸部——无压痛，6 个听诊点呼吸音对称；腹部——柔软、无压痛；背部——视诊无损伤；右上肢——止血带绑在上臂高位并已写上时间，出血已停止，前臂用大量无菌敷料包扎，止血带远端的手冰冷苍白、无脉搏（这是预期之中的），无名指残端已包扎，肩关节活动正常、无畸形；左上肢——正常，CSM 完好；下肢——双侧正常，CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined
expected.actionZh: 头颈部检查。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with six-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查，6 个位置听诊。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined - do not skip it just because the injury is obvious
expected.actionZh: 腹部检查——不要因为损伤部位很显眼就跳过这一项。

expected.actionEn: Back examined
expected.actionZh: 背部检查。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities: document the tourniquet position and time, the dressed wound, the expected absent distal pulse, and examine the shoulder for traction injury
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查：记录止血带的位置和绑扎时间、伤口包扎情况、预期中的远端无脉，并检查肩关节有无牵拉伤。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with CSM
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查，并记录 CSM。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE. HEMORRHAGE ORDER OF PREFERENCE: direct pressure, pressure dressing, positioning the part, positioning the patient, tourniquet - and extremity wound packing only if the bleed cannot be controlled. Here the first two fail, so a tourniquet goes on proximal to the wound, high and tight over a single bone segment of the upper arm, tightened until the bleeding stops. WRITE THE TIME ON IT AND DO NOT RELEASE IT. Wound packing is for junctional bleeds not amenable to a tourniquet - never pack the neck, chest or abdomen - so packing is the wrong answer for a forearm you can tourniquet. Dress the de-gloved forearm with bulky sterile dressings and immobilize the limb, since it has a large wound over a joint-crossing segment. THE AMPUTATED FINGER: rinse it with cool sterile water to remove gross debris, wrap it loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, put it in a plastic bag, and keep that bag cool inside a protective container. Never warm it, never put it in water, never put it directly on ice, never use dry ice, and transport it with the patient. ANALGESIA: he is in shock, and shock is a listed caution for Entonox - withhold it and document the reason; oral analgesia is inappropriate before surgery. OUT OF EMR SCOPE: IV access, a 20 mL/kg fluid bolus, and TXA 2 g - this is the textbook TXA patient, and it is exactly the temptation you must name and hand to the PCP or the trauma centre rather than delay transport for.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围内的处置。止血方法的优先顺序：直接压迫 → 压力绷带 → 抬高患部 → 调整患者体位 → 止血带；只有在出血仍无法控制时才做肢体伤口填塞。本例前两步都失败，因此在伤口近心端上止血带：位置要高、要绑紧，绑在上臂这种单骨节段上，收紧到出血完全停止为止。必须在止血带上写下时间，且一旦绑上就不再松开。伤口填塞是留给「无法用止血带的交界部位出血」的手段——颈部、胸部、腹部绝不可填塞——所以对一条本来就能上止血带的前臂做填塞，是错误答案。用大量无菌敷料包扎脱套的前臂并固定患肢，因为这是一处跨越关节区域的大面积伤口。离断的手指：用冷的无菌水冲洗去除明显污物，用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布松松包裹，装入塑料袋，再把袋子放进保护性容器中保持低温。绝不加温、绝不泡在水里、绝不直接放在冰上、绝不使用干冰，并且必须随患者一起转运。镇痛：患者处于休克状态，而休克是 Entonox 明列的慎用情形——本例不给并记录理由；术前口服镇痛药也不合适。超出 EMR 范围：静脉通路、20 mL/kg 液体复苏和 TXA 2 g——这正是 TXA 的教科书式适应病例，也正是你必须点名并交给 PCP 或创伤中心去做、而绝不能为此拖延转运的那个诱惑。

expected.actionEn: Escalate hemorrhage control in the correct order and apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound as soon as direct pressure and a pressure dressing fail
expected.actionZh: 按正确顺序逐级升级止血措施，一旦直接压迫和压力绷带失败，立即在伤口近心端上止血带。

expected.actionEn: Apply the tourniquet correctly: high on the upper arm over a single bone, never over a joint, tightened until bleeding stops and the distal pulse is gone, time written on it, and never released or loosened
expected.actionZh: 正确使用止血带：绑在上臂高位的单骨节段上，绝不跨关节，收紧到出血停止且远端脉搏消失为止，在止血带上写明时间，且此后绝不松开或放松。

expected.actionEn: Dress the de-gloved forearm with bulky sterile dressings and immobilize the limb, without wasting RTC time on a perfect dressing
expected.actionZh: 用大量无菌敷料包扎脱套的前臂并固定患肢，同时不要为了包得漂亮而浪费 RTC 的宝贵时间。

expected.actionEn: Preserve the amputated finger correctly: rinse with cool sterile water, wrap loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, place in a plastic bag, keep cool in a protective container, and transport it with the patient
expected.actionZh: 正确保存离断的手指：用冷的无菌水冲洗，用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布松松包裹，装入塑料袋，放进保护性容器中保持低温，并随患者一起转运。

expected.actionEn: Execute the hypovolemia care you can do: supine, high-flow oxygen, blankets and warmth, minimal movement and rapid transport
expected.actionZh: 把你能做的低血容量处置做到位：仰卧位、高流量氧、盖毯保暖、减少不必要的搬动、快速转运。

expected.actionEn: Withhold Entonox and state why: shock is a listed caution, and hypotension plus an already reduced perfusion make it the wrong choice here
expected.actionZh: 不给 Entonox 并说明理由：休克是该药明列的慎用情形，低血压加上灌注已经不足，本例用它并不合适。

expected.actionEn: Name TXA and IV fluid as beyond EMR scope, notify the trauma centre so they are ready, and do not delay departure waiting for them
expected.actionZh: 明确指出 TXA 和静脉补液超出 EMR 范围，提前通报创伤中心让他们做好准备，并且绝不为等这些而推迟出发。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the dressings and the tourniquet after every move and at least every 5 minutes: is the bleeding still stopped, has blood soaked through the dressing, is the tourniquet still tight. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1, after the tourniquet, oxygen and warming): GCS 15; BP 96/62; pulse 112 weak; respirations 22; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal; SpO2 97% on 15 L; no further blood loss into the dressings; the hand remains cold and pulseless below the tourniquet, which is expected and must not tempt you to loosen it.
phases.infoZh: 每次搬动之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC、敷料和止血带：出血是不是仍然止住了、敷料有没有被血浸透、止血带是否依然够紧。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟，已上止血带、给氧并保暖）：GCS 15；血压 96/62；脉搏 112 次/分、细弱；呼吸 22 次/分；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大；15 L 氧下 SpO2 97%；敷料未再被血浸透；止血带以下的手仍然冰冷、无脉搏——这是预期结果，绝不能因此心软去放松止血带。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each move and at least every 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 每次搬动之后以及至少每 5 分钟复评一次 ABC 和全部处置。

expected.actionEn: Recheck the dressings and the tourniquet for continued control; add a second tourniquet just proximal to the first if bleeding restarts rather than loosening the first
expected.actionZh: 反复检查敷料和止血带是否仍在有效止血；若再次出血，应在第一条止血带的近心端再加一条，而不是把第一条放松。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes for a priority patient, and interpret the improvement after hemorrhage control
expected.actionZh: 优先患者的第二组完整生命体征应在 7–8 分钟内完成，并解读止血之后病情的改善趋势。

expected.actionEn: Keep him warm and flat; do not sit him up, because he greys out when upright
expected.actionZh: 让他保持平卧和温暖；不要把他扶坐起来，因为他一坐直就会眼前发黑。

expected.actionEn: Re-score the pain and document that Entonox was withheld because of shock
expected.actionZh: 重新做疼痛评分，并记录「因休克而未给 Entonox」这一决定。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - notify the trauma centre early so the hand and vascular teams can be waiting. Hand-off must state the exact time the tourniquet went on, the estimated blood loss, and that the amputated finger has been preserved and travelled with the patient. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——尽早通报创伤中心，好让手外科和血管团队提前待命。交接时必须说明：止血带绑上的确切时间、估计失血量，以及离断的手指已按规范保存并随患者一同送达。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Early trauma-centre notification including the tourniquet time and the amputated digit
expected.actionZh: 尽早向创伤中心预报，内容包含止血带绑上的时间和手指离断这一情况。

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with the mechanism, entrapment time, blood loss estimate, tourniquet time and the preserved part
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：受伤机制、被卡住的时长、估计失血量、止血带时间，以及离断组织的保存情况。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes, documenting the escalation sequence of hemorrhage control
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，并写清止血措施是如何一步步升级的。

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 7 minutes later, after tourniquet, oxygen and warming

criticalPitfallsEn: Staying on direct pressure while the patient bleeds out - when direct pressure and a pressure dressing fail on a limb, the tourniquet goes on, and finding life-threatening hemorrhage without controlling it is a 100% deduction
Packing this forearm wound instead of applying a tourniquet - packing is for junctional bleeds not amenable to a tourniquet, and never on the neck, chest or abdomen
Applying the tourniquet over a joint, over clothing folds, or leaving it loose enough that only venous return is blocked, which increases bleeding
Loosening or releasing the tourniquet en route, or failing to write the application time on it
Putting the amputated finger directly on ice, in water, or in a warm pocket - the correct handling is rinsed, wrapped in saline-moistened gauze, bagged and kept cool
Giving Entonox to a hypotensive patient - shock is a listed caution and it must be withheld and documented
Delaying departure to wait for a PCP so TXA and fluid can be given, or tunnel-visioning on the arm and never examining the head, chest, abdomen and pelvis
criticalPitfallsZh: 眼看着患者失血却还在一味做直接压迫——肢体出血在直接压迫和压力绷带都失败时就该上止血带；发现危及生命的大出血却不控制，扣 100%。
对这处前臂伤口做填塞而不上止血带——填塞是留给「无法使用止血带的交界部位出血」的，而且颈部、胸部、腹部绝不可填塞。
把止血带绑在关节上、绑在衣物褶皱上，或者绑得不够紧只阻断了静脉回流——那样反而会让出血更凶。
在途中松开或放松止血带，或者忘了在止血带上写下绑扎时间。
把离断的手指直接放在冰上、泡在水里，或塞进温暖的口袋——正确做法是冲洗后用生理盐水浸湿的纱布包裹、装袋、保持低温。
给低血压的患者用 Entonox——休克是明列的慎用情形，本例必须不给并记录理由。
为了等 PCP 来上 TXA 和液体而推迟出发，或者只盯着那条手臂、始终没有检查头、胸、腹和骨盆。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: This call is decided entirely by EMR skills. The graded chain is: direct pressure, pressure dressing, then a tourniquet high and tight proximal to the wound with the time written on it and never released; bulky sterile dressings and limb immobilization; correct preservation of the amputated finger - rinsed with cool sterile water, wrapped loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, bagged, kept cool in a container and transported with the patient; high-flow oxygen, supine positioning, warmth and a 15 minute departure. Entonox is withheld because shock is a listed caution. IV fluid and TXA are outside EMR scope and are exactly the wrong reason to stay on scene - notify early instead so the trauma centre gives them the moment you arrive.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这一场的成败完全由 EMR 的基本功决定。评分链条是：直接压迫 → 压力绷带 → 在伤口近心端高位绑紧止血带并写上时间、此后绝不松开；用大量无菌敷料包扎并固定患肢；按规范保存离断手指——用冷的无菌水冲洗、用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布松松包裹、装袋、放入容器保持低温并随患者一起送达；高流量给氧、仰卧位、保暖，并在 15 分钟内出发。因为休克是明列的慎用情形，本例不给 Entonox。静脉补液和 TXA 超出 EMR 范围，而且恰恰是最不该拿来当作滞留现场理由的东西——正确做法是尽早通报，让创伤中心在你一到就能给上。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry, vascular access in the uninjured arm with a 20 mL/kg bolus to a maximum of 2 L reassessed every 500 mL targeting a systolic of 90, and TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute, which is clearly indicated: shock with a mechanism suggesting ongoing haemorrhage, within 3 hours, patient over 12 years, and no isolated traumatic brain injury. PCP also has IV analgesia options that EMR does not, but hypotension still governs the choice.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加：9 系统功能问诊；在未受伤的手臂建立静脉通路，20 mL/kg 快速补液（最多 2 升），每 500 mL 复评一次，目标收缩压 90；并给 TXA 2 g 静脉推注 1 分钟以上——本例指征非常明确：存在休克、受伤机制提示持续出血、在受伤 3 小时内、年龄超过 12 岁，且不是孤立性颅脑损伤。PCP 还有 EMR 没有的静脉镇痛选择，但低血压仍然是决定用不用、用什么的首要因素。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 44-year-old male who caught his glove clearing a jam on a powered roller at 0630 and had his right hand and forearm drawn in; the emergency stop was hit within seconds and it took two to three minutes to free him. He did not fall and did not strike his head. Chief complaint is severe right forearm pain, 10 out of 10. Our findings are a de-gloved right forearm from mid-forearm to the wrist with exposed muscle and a grossly deformed mid-shaft, arterial bleeding that direct pressure and a pressure dressing failed to control, an amputation of the right ring finger at the middle joint, and roughly 700 to 800 millilitres of blood loss on the shop floor. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 88/58, pulse 124 weak, resps 24, SpO2 93% on room air, BGL 5.8, temperature 36.2. Latest vitals BP 96/62, pulse 112, resps 22, SpO2 97% on 15 litres, with no further loss into the dressings. Healthy, no medications, no known allergies, coffee only at 0600 and no food since last night. Treatments: direct pressure, then a pressure dressing, then a windlass tourniquet applied high on the right upper arm at 0651 which stopped the bleeding completely and has not been released; bulky sterile dressings to the forearm with the limb immobilized; the amputated ring finger rinsed with cool sterile saline, wrapped loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, bagged and kept cool in a container, and it is here with him; oxygen 15 litres, supine, blankets. Entonox was withheld because of his shock state. He needs the hand and vascular teams and he has not had any fluid or TXA - that is beyond our scope.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 44 岁男性，06:30 在清理动力滚轮卡料时手套被卷住，右手连同前臂被拖入机器；急停在几秒钟内被拍下，之后花了两三分钟才把他解救出来。他没有跌倒，也没有撞到头。主诉为右前臂剧痛，10/10。我们的发现：右前臂自中段至腕部脱套，肌肉外露，中段明显畸形；动脉性出血，直接压迫和压力绷带均未能控制；右手无名指于中节关节处离断；车间地面失血约 700 至 800 mL。首组生命体征：GCS 15、血压 88/58、脉搏 124 细弱、呼吸 24、室内空气 SpO2 93%、血糖 5.8、体温 36.2。最新一组：血压 96/62、脉搏 112、呼吸 22、15 L 氧下 SpO2 97%，敷料未再被浸透。平素健康，无用药，无已知过敏，06:00 只喝了咖啡，昨晚晚饭后未再进食。我们的处置：先直接压迫，再加压力绷带，均无效后于 06:51 在右上臂高位绑上绞棒式止血带，出血随即完全停止且此后未曾松开；前臂用大量无菌敷料包扎并固定患肢；离断的无名指已用冷的无菌生理盐水冲洗、用浸湿的无菌纱布松松包裹、装袋后放入容器保持低温，现随患者一同送达；15 L 给氧、仰卧位、盖毯保暖。因患者处于休克状态，未给 Entonox。他需要手外科和血管团队；我们没有给任何液体或 TXA，这些超出我们的执业范围。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Right forearm crush and de-gloving injury with uncontrolled arterial bleeding
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Right hand and forearm drawn into a powered roller at 0630 while clearing a jam, emergency stop within seconds, entrapped 2-3 minutes, no fall and no head strike; pain 10/10 burning and crushing; estimated 700-800 mL blood loss on scene
treatments: Direct pressure, then pressure dressing - both failed to control the bleeding
Windlass tourniquet applied high on the right upper arm at 0651, tightened until bleeding stopped, time marked, not released
De-gloved forearm dressed with bulky sterile dressings, limb immobilized

Amputated right ring finger rinsed with cool sterile saline, wrapped loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze, placed in a plastic bag, kept cool in a protective container, transported with the patient - not on ice, not in water, not warmed
Oxygen 15 L NRB, supine positioning, blankets for warmth
Entonox withheld - shock is a listed caution
RTC to trauma centre with early notification for hand and vascular teams; IV fluid and TXA noted as beyond EMR scope
findings: De-gloved right forearm mid-forearm to wrist, exposed muscle, grossly deformed mid-shaft
Right hand cold and mottled with no radial pulse before the tourniquet; expected absent pulse after
Right ring finger amputated at the middle joint, part recovered
Haemorrhagic shock: BP 88/58 improving to 96/62, pulse 124 falling to 112, pale cool clammy skin
No head, neck, chest, abdominal or pelvic injury; shoulder sore from traction with no deformity
Bleeding completely controlled after tourniquet application at 0651

scenarios.titleEn: Shallow-Water Dive Drowning - Cardiac Arrest With a Suspected Cervical Injury
scenarios.titleZh: 浅水跳水溺水——心搏骤停合并可疑颈椎损伤
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1520 hrs, August long weekend. Code 3 to the main beach at Cultus Lake near Chilliwack. A 16-year-old male dove head-first from a dock into shallow water, did not resurface, and was pulled out by friends after roughly three minutes. Bystander CPR is in progress. Air temperature 28 degrees C, water temperature 19 degrees C, sunny. Fire first responders arrive with you and have an AED. Chilliwack General Hospital is 20 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 8 月长周末 15:20，Code 3 前往 Chilliwack 附近 Cultus 湖主沙滩。一名 16 岁男孩从码头头朝下跳入浅水区后没有浮上来，约三分钟后被同伴拖上岸。旁观者正在做 CPR。气温 28 摄氏度，水温 19 摄氏度，晴天。消防第一响应队与你同时到达，并带着 AED。Chilliwack 综合医院距离 20 分钟车程。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: bystanders say he went in head-first off a dock into about one metre of water and they saw him floating face down. Two lifeguards started compressions on the sand about one minute ago. A large crowd has gathered and police are two minutes out.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：旁观者说他从码头头朝下跳进了大约一米深的水里，后来看到他脸朝下漂在水面。两名救生员大约一分钟前在沙滩上开始了胸外按压。现场已聚集大量围观人群，警察还有两分钟到达。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge and plan for a resuscitation with a spinal problem: AED, BVM and oxygen, suction, airway adjuncts, collar, scoop, towels and blankets, all carried to the patient in one trip
expected.actionZh: 确认信息，并按「复苏合并脊柱损伤」来准备：AED、BVM 和氧气、吸引器、口咽/鼻咽通气管、颈托、铲式担架、毛巾和毯子，一次性全部带到患者身边。

expected.actionEn: Decide the priority before you arrive: in cardiac arrest, resuscitation comes first and spinal precautions are maintained by hand during it - the two are done together, not one after the other
expected.actionZh: 在到场之前就把优先级想清楚：心搏骤停时复苏优先，脊柱防护则在复苏过程中用徒手固定同步维持——这两件事是同时做，而不是先做完一件再做另一件。

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Crowded public beach, hot sun, soft sand. The patient is on the sand about 5 metres from the waterline, wet, in swim shorts. Two lifeguards are doing compressions on the sand - which is soft and compresses under him. A crowd of about forty people is close in and several are filming; his mother is being brought over by a friend. Police arrive and take over crowd control. One patient. Fire has the AED in hand.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：公共沙滩人很多，烈日当空，沙子松软。患者躺在距水线约 5 米的沙地上，全身湿透，只穿泳裤。两名救生员正在沙地上做胸外按压——沙子很软，按压时身下会下陷。约四十人的围观人群紧紧围着，好几个人在拍视频；他的母亲正被朋友搀扶过来。警察到场后接管人群控制。现场只有一名患者。消防手里已经拿好 AED。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (crowd, filming bystanders, water, hot sand, your own footing), environment, MOI (head-first dive into approximately one metre of water, roughly three minutes submerged) and people (one patient, lifeguards, family)
expected.actionZh: 口头说出危险源（围观人群、正在拍摄的旁观者、水域、滚烫的沙子、自身站位是否稳当）、环境、受伤机制（头朝下跳入约一米深的水中，水下约三分钟）和人员（一名患者、救生员、家属）。

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection; ask police to move the crowd back and to manage the people filming, and get the patient onto a hard surface such as a backboard or the scoop because compressions on soft sand are ineffective
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜；请警察把人群往后隔开并处理拍摄者，同时尽快把患者移到硬质平面（长脊板或铲式担架）上——在松软沙地上做的按压是无效的。

expected.actionEn: First look: teenage male, cyanotic, wet, unresponsive, with foam at the mouth and CPR in progress on an unstable surface
expected.actionZh: 第一眼印象：青少年男性，发绀、全身湿透、无反应，口周有泡沫，正在一个不稳固的表面上接受 CPR。

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: unresponsive, no movement, no response to pain. EXAMINER (give as assessed): airway contains water and frothy vomit - suction is needed, adult suction time is 10 to 15 seconds; there is no gag reflex, so an OPA is appropriate. Breathing: apneic. Circulation: no carotid pulse on a 10 second check. Skin cyanotic, cool and wet. RAPID BODY SURVEY: a 4 cm abrasion and swelling over the forehead and the bridge of the nose consistent with striking the bottom, no other injury, no bleeding, chest and abdomen unremarkable, pelvis stable. THIS IS A CARDIAC ARREST FROM ASPHYXIA. Resuscitation begins immediately with manual in-line stabilization maintained by a second rescuer; do NOT delay compressions to apply a collar or board. AED sequence: with two rescuers, apply the AED while one-person CPR continues for 5 cycles or about 2 minutes, then analyze. FIRST ANALYSIS: NO SHOCK ADVISED - resume CPR immediately. After a further 2 minutes of CPR he coughs, gags and starts weak spontaneous breathing at 6 per minute with a carotid pulse of 118. ROSC at approximately 4 minutes after your arrival.
phases.infoZh: 演员表现：无反应、无自主动作、对疼痛刺激无反应。考官（按考生评估进度给出）：气道内有水和带泡沫的呕吐物——必须吸引，成人一次吸引时间为 10 至 15 秒；无咽反射，因此适合放置口咽通气管（OPA）。呼吸：无自主呼吸。循环：10 秒检查颈动脉，无搏动。皮肤发绀、湿冷。快速体格检查：前额和鼻梁处有 4 厘米擦伤和肿胀，符合头部撞击水底的表现；除此之外无其他损伤，无出血，胸腹无异常，骨盆稳定。这是一例窒息性心搏骤停。必须立即开始复苏，同时由第二名救护员用徒手轴线固定维持颈椎保护；绝不可为了上颈托或搬上脊板而推迟胸外按压。AED 流程：两名救护员在场时，一边贴 AED 一边继续单人 CPR 5 个循环（约 2 分钟），然后再分析。首次分析结果：不建议电击——立即恢复 CPR。再做 2 分钟 CPR 后，他出现咳嗽、干呕，并以 6 次/分开始微弱的自主呼吸，颈动脉搏动 118 次/分。自主循环恢复（ROSC）出现在你到达后约 4 分钟。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: unresponsive
expected.actionZh: 评估意识水平 / AVPU：无反应。

expected.actionEn: Maintain manual in-line stabilization by a second rescuer throughout the resuscitation - a head-first dive into shallow water is a high-risk cervical mechanism, but this is done by hand and never at the cost of delaying compressions
expected.actionZh: 在整个复苏过程中由第二名救护员维持徒手轴线固定——头朝下跳入浅水是颈椎损伤的高危机制；但这一固定靠手来完成，绝不能以推迟胸外按压为代价。

expected.actionEn: Open the airway with a JAW THRUST, not a head-tilt chin-lift, suction the water and vomit for no more than 10 to 15 seconds, and insert an OPA once you confirm there is no gag reflex
expected.actionZh: 用推举下颌（jaw thrust）而不是仰头抬颏法开放气道，吸引水和呕吐物且单次不超过 10 至 15 秒，确认无咽反射后置入口咽通气管。

expected.actionEn: Confirm apnea and ventilate with a BVM and high-flow oxygen with a good seal; do not attempt to drain water from the lungs and do not perform abdominal thrusts
expected.actionZh: 确认无自主呼吸后，用 BVM 接高流量氧、保持良好面罩密闭进行通气；不要试图把肺里的水「控出来」，也不要做腹部冲击。

expected.actionEn: Confirm pulselessness on a 10 second carotid check and start high-quality compressions at 100-120 per minute, 5 to 6 cm deep, ratio 30:2, with full recoil and interruptions under 5 seconds
expected.actionZh: 用 10 秒检查颈动脉确认无脉后，立即开始高质量胸外按压：频率 100–120 次/分、深度 5 至 6 厘米、按压通气比 30:2、每次按压后胸廓完全回弹、中断时间不超过 5 秒。

expected.actionEn: Move him onto a hard surface for effective compressions - compressions on soft sand are ineffective, and the transfer doubles as the spinal packaging
expected.actionZh: 把他移到硬质平面上以保证按压有效——在松软沙地上按压是无效的；而这一次转移同时也完成了脊柱打包。

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey once the resuscitation is running: identify the forehead abrasion as evidence of striking the bottom, and rule out other injury
expected.actionZh: 复苏一旦运转起来就完成快速体格检查：把前额擦伤识别为撞击水底的证据，并排除其他损伤。

expected.actionEn: Note the skin as cyanotic, cool and wet
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：发绀、湿冷。

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen attached to the BVM during arrest and maintained after ROSC, targeting SpO2 at or above 94% without hyperventilating
expected.actionZh: 复苏期间把高流量氧接到 BVM 上，ROSC 之后继续给氧，目标 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上，同时避免过度通气。

expected.actionEn: Remove the wet swim shorts, dry him and cover him with blankets - even on a hot day a wet patient loses heat fast, and after ROSC he stays supine on the spinal device rather than sitting up
expected.actionZh: 脱掉湿泳裤、擦干身体并盖毯保暖——即使是大热天，湿着身体的患者也会迅速失温；ROSC 之后他要仰卧在脊柱固定装置上，而不是坐起来。

phases.infoEn: Decision point. A post-arrest patient with a decreased LOC, inadequate respirations and a suspected cervical spine injury is Rapid Transport Category and remains one after ROSC. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Note the guideline nuance: a conscious near-drowning patient is positioned sitting up, but this patient has had a cardiac arrest and a high-risk cervical mechanism, so he stays supine and fully immobilized with suction at his head, and you tip the whole device if he vomits.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。心搏骤停复苏后、意识水平下降、通气不足并怀疑颈椎损伤的患者属于 RTC，且在 ROSC 之后仍然是 RTC。15 分钟内完成装载准备。请注意指南上的细微差别：清醒的溺水患者要采取坐起体位，但本例发生过心搏骤停且有颈椎损伤高危机制，因此他必须保持仰卧并完全固定，吸引器放在他头侧，一旦呕吐就整块固定装置一起侧倾。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and keep that category after ROSC
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC，并在 ROSC 之后继续维持该分类。

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes with full spinal packaging completed during the resuscitation rather than after it
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内完成装载准备，脊柱打包应在复苏过程中同步完成，而不是等复苏结束后再做。

expected.actionEn: Use lifeguards, fire and police effectively: compressions, equipment, crowd control and family support, while you keep the airway and the resuscitation running
expected.actionZh: 有效调度救生员、消防和警察：分别负责按压、器材、人群控制和家属安抚，而你专注于气道管理和复苏本身的运转。

phases.infoEn: HISTORY FROM FRIENDS AND LIFEGUARDS (the patient cannot speak): he ran off the end of the dock and dove head-first into water they estimate at about one metre deep, roughly 15 minutes ago. He did not resurface. His friends thought he was joking for about a minute, then pulled him out face down and unresponsive after about three minutes in the water. The lifeguards started compressions immediately on the sand. No alcohol or drugs that the friends know of, though they hesitate when asked. MOTHER (arrives during the resuscitation): he is healthy, has asthma with a blue inhaler he rarely uses, no other conditions, no medications daily, allergic to shellfish with swelling, and he ate a hot dog and a slushie about an hour ago.
phases.infoZh: 病史来自同伴和救生员（患者无法说话）：他从码头尽头跑着头朝下跳进水里，他们估计水深约一米，时间大约在 15 分钟前。他没有再浮上来。同伴起初以为他在开玩笑，过了约一分钟才觉得不对，在他入水约三分钟后把他脸朝下地拖上岸，当时已无反应。救生员立刻在沙滩上开始了胸外按压。据同伴所知没有饮酒或用药，但被问到时他们有些迟疑。母亲（在复苏过程中赶到）：他身体健康，有哮喘、有一支很少用的蓝色吸入器，无其他疾病，平时不吃任何药，对贝类过敏会肿，大约一小时前吃了一个热狗、喝了一杯冰沙。

expected.actionEn: Establish the chief complaint: cardiac arrest following a shallow-water head-first dive and submersion
expected.actionZh: 确定主诉：浅水区头朝下跳水并溺水后发生心搏骤停。

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from bystanders covering the drowning specifics: water depth, head-first entry, submersion time, time to first compressions, what was done by bystanders, water temperature, and any alcohol or drug use
expected.actionZh: 向旁观者采集现病史，覆盖溺水的关键细节：水深、是否头朝下入水、水下时长、从入水到开始按压的时间、旁观者做了什么、水温，以及有无饮酒或用药。

expected.actionEn: Pain cannot be scored in an unresponsive patient - document that and re-attempt as the LOC improves
expected.actionZh: 无反应的患者无法做疼痛评分——如实记录，并在意识水平改善后重新尝试评估。

expected.actionEn: Past medical history from the mother, including the asthma
expected.actionZh: 向母亲采集既往病史，包括哮喘。

expected.actionEn: Medications, including the inhaler and anything taken today
expected.actionZh: 用药史，包括那支吸入器以及今天服用过的任何东西。

expected.actionEn: Allergies - shellfish with swelling
expected.actionZh: 过敏史——贝类过敏，会出现肿胀。

expected.actionEn: Last oral intake - a full stomach an hour before submersion raises the aspiration risk
expected.actionZh: 最后进食进饮——溺水前一小时刚吃饱，会显著增加误吸风险。

phases.infoEn: Set 1 (immediately post-ROSC, en route): GCS 6 (E1 V2 M3); BP 92/60; pulse 118 weak and regular; respirations 6 and agonal - you are assisting with a BVM at 10 to 12 per minute; skin cyanotic improving to pale, cool and wet; pupils 5 mm bilaterally, equal and sluggish; SpO2 84% rising to 95% with BVM and 15 L oxygen; BGL 5.6 mmol/L; temperature 34.8 C from 19 degree water on a wet body.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组（ROSC 后立即测量，途中）：GCS 6（E1 V2 M3）；血压 92/60；脉搏 118 次/分、细弱规则；呼吸 6 次/分、呈叹息样——你正在用 BVM 以 10 至 12 次/分辅助通气；皮肤由发绀转为苍白、湿冷；瞳孔双侧 5 毫米、等大、对光反应迟钝；SpO2 从 84% 在 BVM 加 15 L 氧下升至 95%；血糖 5.6 mmol/L；体温 34.8 摄氏度——19 摄氏度的湖水加上湿着身体所致。

expected.actionEn: GCS with all three components, repeated frequently after ROSC
expected.actionZh: GCS 评分并分别说出三项分值，ROSC 之后要频繁复测。

expected.actionEn: Blood pressure - the first post-ROSC blood pressure is a key number for the receiving team
expected.actionZh: 血压——ROSC 后的第一个血压值对接收团队而言是关键数据。

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate, rhythm and quality, checked centrally and rechecked frequently in case of re-arrest
expected.actionZh: 脉搏的频率、节律和强弱，在中心动脉检查并频繁复查，以防再次骤停。

expected.actionEn: Respirations - 6 and agonal is inadequate and must be supported, not just recorded
expected.actionZh: 呼吸——6 次/分的叹息样呼吸属于通气不足，必须给予支持，而不是只记个数字。

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed hands-on
expected.actionZh: 用手实际触摸评估皮肤。

expected.actionEn: Pupils - size and reaction are the key neurological observation after a hypoxic arrest
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——缺氧性心搏骤停之后，瞳孔大小与对光反应是最关键的神经系统观察指标。

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with the target at or above 94% while avoiding hyperventilation
expected.actionZh: SpO2 目标维持在 94% 及以上，同时避免过度通气。

expected.actionEn: Blood glucose - mandatory with a decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 血糖——意识水平下降时必测。

expected.actionEn: Temperature - a wet patient from 19 degree water is hypothermic even on a hot beach day
expected.actionZh: 体温——在 19 摄氏度湖水中泡过又湿着身体的患者，即使在炎热的沙滩上也会低体温。

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, and in this case it is taken from the mother rather than the patient because he is post-arrest with a GCS of 6. General - healthy, plays soccer, no recent illness; CNS - no previous head injury, no seizures; respiratory - asthma diagnosed at age 8, blue inhaler used maybe twice a year, no recent flare; cardiovascular - no known heart problem, no fainting, no family history of sudden death; GI/GU - nil; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - nil; endocrine - nil; EENT - nil. Ask the mother specifically about a family history of sudden cardiac death or unexplained drowning, because that changes the working diagnosis.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP 需要；本例因患者复苏后 GCS 只有 6 分，问诊对象改为母亲。全身健康——身体健康，踢足球，近期无疾病；中枢神经——无既往颅脑外伤，无抽搐史；呼吸——8 岁确诊哮喘，蓝色吸入器一年大概用两次，近期无发作；心血管——无已知心脏病，无晕厥史，家族中无猝死史；消化/泌尿——无异常；皮肤——无异常；肌肉骨骼——无异常；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。要特别向母亲询问家族中有无心源性猝死或不明原因溺水史，因为这会改变初步诊断方向。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——全身健康状况。

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——中枢神经系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (the asthma history matters for both the arrest and the post-ROSC ventilation)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——呼吸系统（哮喘史对判断骤停原因和 ROSC 后的通气管理都有意义）。

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (family history of sudden death would suggest a primary cardiac event rather than a simple drowning)
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——心血管系统（家族猝死史会提示这可能是原发心脏事件，而不仅仅是单纯溺水）。

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——消化/泌尿系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——皮肤。

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——肌肉骨骼系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——内分泌系统。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 系统问诊——眼耳鼻喉。

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe on the immobilized patient: head/neck - 4 cm forehead abrasion with swelling over the bridge of the nose, no depression, no blood from the ears, collar in place and inspected before application; chest - equal air entry with coarse crackles at both bases from aspiration, no rib injury, no chest wall deformity; abdomen - distended with swallowed water and air, soft; back - checked during the transfer onto the device, no deformity or tenderness elicited; upper extremities - no injury, but note that in an unresponsive patient you cannot assess sensation or motor function, so document CSM as unassessable rather than normal; lower extremities - no injury, same limitation, and pedal pulses present bilaterally.
phases.infoZh: 途中对已固定的患者做从头到脚检查：头颈——前额 4 厘米擦伤，鼻梁处肿胀，无颅骨凹陷，耳道无出血；颈托已上，且在上颈托之前已完成颈部视诊触诊。胸部——双肺呼吸音对称，双肺底可闻及误吸引起的粗湿啰音，无肋骨损伤，胸廓无畸形。腹部——因吞入大量水和空气而膨隆，但触之柔软。背部——在移上固定装置时检查，未发现畸形或压痛。上肢——无外伤；但要注意：患者无反应时你无法评估感觉和运动，因此 CSM 应记录为「无法评估」而不是「正常」。下肢——无外伤，同样存在上述评估限制，双侧足背动脉搏动可及。

expected.actionEn: Head and neck examined before the collar is applied, with the forehead injury documented as evidence of the impact
expected.actionZh: 在上颈托之前完成头颈检查，并把前额损伤记录为撞击水底的证据。

expected.actionEn: Chest examined with six-site auscultation; crackles at both bases indicate aspiration
expected.actionZh: 胸部检查，6 个位置听诊；双肺底湿啰音提示误吸。

expected.actionEn: Abdomen examined - gastric distension from swallowed water raises the vomiting and aspiration risk
expected.actionZh: 腹部检查——吞入大量水造成的胃扩张会大幅增加呕吐和误吸风险。

expected.actionEn: Back examined during the transfer onto the spinal device
expected.actionZh: 在把患者移上脊柱固定装置时检查背部。

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities examined, with sensation and motor documented as unassessable in an unresponsive patient
expected.actionZh: 上肢检查；因患者无反应，感觉和运动应记录为「无法评估」。

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities examined with pedal pulses documented
expected.actionZh: 下肢检查，并记录双侧足背动脉搏动。

phases.infoEn: EMR SCOPE, and this call is a scope showcase. CPR: 30:2 with adult ratios and adult AED pads - a 16-year-old past puberty is managed as an adult; rate 100-120, depth 5-6 cm, full recoil, interruptions under 5 seconds, change compressors every 2 minutes. ASPHYXIAL ARREST RULE: with two rescuers, apply the AED while one-person CPR runs for 5 cycles or about 2 minutes, then analyze; if you were alone, you would do 5 cycles of CPR before applying the AED at all. AIRWAY: jaw thrust, suction 10 to 15 seconds at a time in an adult, OPA once there is no gag, BVM with high-flow oxygen and a good seal, and do NOT try to expel water from the lungs or perform abdominal thrusts. SPINAL: manual in-line stabilization from the moment you arrive, collar applied when it does not interrupt compressions, and the transfer onto a hard device serves both the CPR surface and the spinal packaging. POST-ROSC: keep assisting ventilations at 10-12 per minute targeting SpO2 at or above 94%, do not hyperventilate, remove wet clothing, dry him, blanket him against a 34.8 degree temperature, keep him supine on the device with suction in your hand, and be ready to tip the whole device if he vomits. FAMILY: his mother is present - assign someone to stay with her and tell her the truth simply. OUT OF EMR SCOPE: CPAP or PEEP, a supraglottic airway, IV access and any drug therapy.
phases.infoZh: EMR 授权范围内的处置——这一场正是 EMR 能力的集中展示。CPR：按成人比例 30:2，使用成人 AED 电极片——16 岁已过青春期，按成人处理；频率 100–120 次/分，深度 5–6 厘米，每次按压后胸廓完全回弹，中断不超过 5 秒，每 2 分钟换人按压。窒息性骤停规则：两名救护员在场时，一边贴 AED 一边继续单人 CPR 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）再分析；如果你是单独一人，则应先做 5 个循环 CPR 再去贴 AED。气道：推举下颌开放气道；成人每次吸引 10 至 15 秒；确认无咽反射后置入口咽通气管；用 BVM 接高流量氧并保持良好密闭；不要试图把肺里的水排出，也不要做腹部冲击。脊柱：从到场那一刻起就维持徒手轴线固定；在不中断按压的前提下上颈托；把患者移到硬质装置上这一步，既提供了有效按压的平面，也同时完成了脊柱打包。ROSC 之后：继续以 10–12 次/分辅助通气，目标 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上，避免过度通气；脱掉湿衣物、擦干身体、盖毯应对 34.8 摄氏度的低体温；保持仰卧固定在装置上，吸引器拿在手里，一旦呕吐立刻整块装置侧倾。家属：母亲就在现场——安排一个人陪着她，并用简单直白的话把实情告诉她。超出 EMR 范围：CPAP 或 PEEP、声门上气道装置、静脉通路以及任何药物治疗。

expected.actionEn: High-quality CPR at adult ratios: 30:2, 100-120 per minute, 5-6 cm deep, full recoil, interruptions under 5 seconds, compressor changed every 2 minutes
expected.actionZh: 按成人标准做高质量 CPR：30:2、100–120 次/分、深度 5–6 厘米、胸廓完全回弹、中断不超过 5 秒、每 2 分钟换人按压。

expected.actionEn: Apply the AED with adult pads and follow the asphyxial arrest sequence: with two rescuers, apply the AED during 5 cycles of one-person CPR, then analyze; resume CPR immediately when no shock is advised
expected.actionZh: 贴上成人电极片使用 AED，并遵循窒息性骤停流程：两名救护员在场时，在完成 5 个循环单人 CPR 的同时贴好 AED，然后再分析；提示「不建议电击」时立即恢复 CPR。

expected.actionEn: Airway management: jaw thrust, suction for no more than 10 to 15 seconds at a time, OPA once there is no gag reflex, and BVM ventilation with high-flow oxygen and a good mask seal
expected.actionZh: 气道管理：推举下颌开放气道，单次吸引不超过 10 至 15 秒，确认无咽反射后置入口咽通气管，并用 BVM 接高流量氧、保持良好面罩密闭进行通气。

expected.actionEn: Maintain manual in-line stabilization throughout the arrest and complete the spinal packaging during the transfer onto the hard device - never delay compressions for a collar
expected.actionZh: 在整个心搏骤停过程中维持徒手轴线固定，并在把患者移上硬质装置的同时完成脊柱打包——绝不能为了上颈托而推迟按压。

expected.actionEn: After ROSC assist ventilations at 10-12 per minute targeting SpO2 at or above 94% without hyperventilating, and keep reassessing for re-arrest
expected.actionZh: ROSC 之后以 10–12 次/分辅助通气，目标 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上且不过度通气，并持续复评有无再次骤停。

expected.actionEn: Remove wet clothing, dry him and cover him with blankets to manage the 34.8 degree temperature, and keep him supine on the device rather than sitting up because of the arrest and the spinal mechanism
expected.actionZh: 脱掉湿衣物、擦干身体并盖毯保暖以处理 34.8 摄氏度的低体温；因发生过心搏骤停且有颈椎损伤机制，让他仰卧固定在装置上而不是坐起来。

expected.actionEn: Assign a crew member or police officer to the mother, and delegate crowd control so bystanders are not filming the resuscitation
expected.actionZh: 指派一名队员或警察陪同母亲，并把人群控制交出去，避免旁观者对着复苏现场拍摄。

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs every 2 to 3 minutes after ROSC - re-arrest is common. Set 2 (en route, 7 minutes after set 1, with assisted ventilation and warming): GCS 8 (E2 V2 M4); BP 100/64; pulse 108; respirations 10 with assistance, now with some spontaneous effort; skin pale and cool but no longer cyanotic; pupils 4 mm and more reactive; SpO2 97% on BVM with 15 L; temperature 35.2 C. He gags and vomits once - suction immediately, tip the whole spinal device as a unit, and continue. Keep the AED on him for the entire transport.
phases.infoZh: ROSC 之后每 2 至 3 分钟复评一次 ABC——再次骤停很常见。第 2 组（途中，第 1 组之后 7 分钟，已辅助通气并保暖）：GCS 8（E2 V2 M4）；血压 100/64；脉搏 108 次/分；在辅助通气下呼吸 10 次/分，并已出现部分自主呼吸努力；皮肤苍白发凉但已不再发绀；瞳孔 4 毫米，对光反应较前灵敏；BVM 接 15 L 氧下 SpO2 97%；体温 35.2 摄氏度。途中他干呕并呕吐一次——立即吸引，把整块脊柱固定装置作为一个整体侧倾，然后继续处置。整个转运过程中 AED 都要一直贴在他身上。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs every 2 to 3 minutes post-ROSC and after every move
expected.actionZh: ROSC 之后每 2 至 3 分钟以及每次搬动之后都复评一次 ABC。

expected.actionEn: Manage the vomiting immediately: suction, tip the whole immobilized patient as a unit, and never remove the straps to roll him
expected.actionZh: 立即处理呕吐：吸引，把已固定的患者连同装置作为一个整体侧倾，绝不可解开约束带把他翻过来。

expected.actionEn: Keep the AED attached for the whole transport in case of re-arrest
expected.actionZh: 整个转运过程中 AED 保持贴附在患者身上，以防再次骤停。

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 7-8 minutes for a priority patient, with the improving GCS and pupils reported as a trend
expected.actionZh: 优先患者的第二组完整生命体征应在 7–8 分钟内完成，并把 GCS 和瞳孔的改善作为趋势报告出来。

expected.actionEn: Repeat the temperature and continue passive warming with dry blankets
expected.actionZh: 复测体温，并用干燥毯子继续被动保温。

phases.infoEn: Priority patient - notify the hospital as soon as you have ROSC so the team is assembled. Hand-off must include the submersion time, the down time before compressions, the total arrest duration, the time of ROSC, the AED analysis result, and the fact that spinal precautions were maintained throughout. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 优先患者——一旦出现 ROSC 就立即通知医院，好让抢救团队集结待命。交接内容必须包括：水下时长、开始按压前的空白时间、心搏骤停总时长、ROSC 的时间、AED 分析结果，以及全程维持了脊柱防护这一事实。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Notify the receiving hospital immediately on ROSC, including submersion and arrest times
expected.actionZh: 一出现 ROSC 就立即通报接收医院，内容包含水下时长和骤停时长。

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with the resuscitation timeline, the AED result, the post-ROSC course and the spinal precautions
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：复苏时间线、AED 分析结果、ROSC 后的病情演变，以及脊柱防护措施。

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes with all resuscitation times recorded
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确的 PCR，并把复苏过程中的各个时间点全部记录下来。

vitalsSets.spo2: 84% rising to 95% with BVM and 15 L

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route, 7 minutes later, with assisted ventilation and warming
vitalsSets.skin: pale and cool, no longer cyanotic

criticalPitfallsEn: Delaying compressions to apply a collar or a board - in cardiac arrest, spinal precautions are maintained by hand while resuscitation runs, and not intervening on an absent pulse is a 100% deduction
Abandoning spinal precautions entirely because it is an arrest - a head-first dive into one metre of water is a high-risk cervical mechanism and manual stabilization must be maintained
Compressing on soft sand and never moving him onto a hard surface - the compressions look correct and achieve nothing
Using a head-tilt chin-lift instead of a jaw thrust, or trying to drain water from the lungs or perform abdominal thrusts
Suctioning for longer than 10 to 15 seconds in an adult, or pausing compressions for more than 5 seconds for airway work
Getting the asphyxial arrest AED sequence wrong - with two rescuers you apply the AED during 5 cycles of CPR and then analyze; if alone you complete 5 cycles before applying it

Hyperventilating after ROSC, leaving him in wet clothing at 34.8 degrees, or sitting him up because the drowning guideline says to sit patients up - that instruction is for the conscious patient without a spinal mechanism
criticalPitfallsZh: 为了上颈托或搬上脊板而推迟胸外按压——心搏骤停时脊柱防护靠徒手维持、复苏同时进行；判断出无脉却不干预扣 100%。
因为「这是心搏骤停」就把脊柱防护完全丢掉——头朝下跳进一米深的水里属于颈椎损伤高危机制，徒手轴线固定必须全程维持。
一直在松软沙地上按压、始终没把他移到硬质平面——那样的按压看着像模像样，实际上毫无效果。
用仰头抬颏法代替推举下颌，或者试图把肺里的水控出来、做腹部冲击。
成人单次吸引超过 10 至 15 秒，或为了处理气道让按压中断超过 5 秒。
把窒息性骤停的 AED 流程搞错——两名救护员在场时应边做 5 个循环 CPR 边贴 AED，然后再分析；单独一人时则应先做完 5 个循环再贴 AED。
ROSC 后过度通气、让他在 34.8 摄氏度体温下继续穿着湿衣服，或者因为溺水指南写着「让患者坐起来」就把他扶坐起来——那条指示是给没有颈椎损伤机制的清醒患者的。
scenarios.emrVariantEn: This entire resuscitation is EMR scope and it is graded on the mechanics: high-quality 30:2 adult CPR on a hard surface, adult AED pads with the asphyxial sequence of 5 cycles of CPR before analysis, jaw thrust with suction limited to 10-15 seconds and an OPA once the gag is gone, BVM with high-flow oxygen and a good seal, manual in-line stabilization from arrival with the collar and device applied without interrupting compressions, and post-ROSC assisted ventilation at 10-12 per minute targeting SpO2 at or above 94%. Wet clothing off, patient dried and blanketed for a temperature of 34.8, kept supine on the device with suction in hand, and the AED left attached the whole way. CPAP or PEEP, a supraglottic airway, IV access and drugs are all beyond EMR - none of them are needed to run this call correctly.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: 这整场复苏都在 EMR 授权范围内，评分看的就是这些基本功：在硬质平面上按成人 30:2 做高质量 CPR；使用成人 AED 电极片并遵循窒息性骤停流程（先做 5 个循环 CPR 再分析）；推举下颌开放气道，单次吸引不超过 10 至 15 秒，无咽反射后置入口咽通气管；用 BVM 接高流量氧并保持良好密闭；从到场起维持徒手轴线固定，在不中断按压的前提下完成颈托和固定装置；ROSC 后以 10–12 次/分辅助通气，目标 SpO2 维持在 94% 及以上。脱掉湿衣服、擦干身体、盖毯处理 34.8 摄氏度的低体温，保持仰卧固定并把吸引器拿在手里，AED 全程不撤。CPAP/PEEP、声门上气道、静脉通路和药物都超出 EMR 范围——而把这一场跑对，本来也用不到它们。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds the 9-system Functional Enquiry taken from the mother, a supraglottic airway once high-quality arrest management is established, vascular access, and PEEP or CPAP after ROSC if it is indicated for the aspiration picture. The resuscitation mechanics, the asphyxial AED sequence and the spinal precautions are identical at both levels.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在此基础上追加：向母亲采集 9 系统功能问诊；在高质量骤停管理已经建立后置入声门上气道；建立静脉通路；ROSC 之后若误吸表现有指征，可使用 PEEP 或 CPAP。至于复苏的操作要领、窒息性骤停的 AED 流程和脊柱防护，两个级别的要求完全一致。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 16-year-old male who dove head-first from a dock into approximately one metre of water at about 1505, struck the bottom and did not resurface. He was submerged for roughly three minutes and was pulled out unresponsive and apneic. Lifeguards started bystander compressions on the sand about one minute before our arrival. On our arrival he was in cardiac arrest - apneic, no carotid pulse, cyanotic, with water and frothy vomit in the airway. We suctioned, used a jaw thrust with an OPA, ventilated with a BVM on 15 litres, moved him onto a hard device which also completed his spinal packaging, and ran 30 to 2 adult CPR. The AED was applied during the first 5 cycles and advised no shock. We achieved ROSC approximately 4 minutes after arrival, so the total arrest duration was roughly 9 minutes with a bystander down time of about 2 minutes. Post-ROSC vitals were GCS 6, BP 92/60, pulse 118, agonal respirations of 6 which we are assisting at 10 to 12, SpO2 84 rising to 95, BGL 5.6 and temperature 34.8. Current vitals GCS 8, BP 100/64, pulse 108, SpO2 97 on the BVM, temperature 35.2, and pupils are 4 millimetres and more reactive. He vomited once en route and we suctioned and tipped the whole device. He is asthmatic with a rarely used blue inhaler, no daily medications, allergic to shellfish with swelling, and he ate about an hour before the dive. Manual in-line stabilization was maintained from our arrival and he has a forehead abrasion consistent with striking the bottom, so full spinal precautions remain in place.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 这是一名 16 岁男性，约 15:05 从码头头朝下跳入约一米深的水中，撞到水底后没有再浮上来。他在水下约三分钟，被拖上岸时已无反应、无自主呼吸。救生员在我们到达前约一分钟已在沙滩上开始旁观者按压。我们到场时他处于心搏骤停状态——无呼吸、颈动脉无搏动、全身发绀，气道内有水和带泡沫的呕吐物。我们做了吸引，用推举下颌手法开放气道并置入口咽通气管，用 BVM 接 15 L 氧通气，把他移到硬质装置上（这一步同时完成了脊柱打包），按成人 30:2 做 CPR。AED 在最初 5 个循环期间贴好，分析结果为「不建议电击」。到达后约 4 分钟恢复自主循环，因此骤停总时长约 9 分钟，其中旁观者未按压的空白时间约 2 分钟。ROSC 后首组生命体征：GCS 6、血压 92/60、脉搏 118、叹息样呼吸 6 次/分（我们以 10–12 次/分辅助）、SpO2 由 84% 升至 95%、血糖 5.6、体温 34.8。目前：GCS 8、血压 100/64、脉搏 108、BVM 通气下 SpO2 97%、体温 35.2，瞳孔 4 毫米、对光反应较前灵敏。途中呕吐一次，我们立即吸引并把整块固定装置侧倾。他有哮喘，蓝色吸入器很少使用，平时不服药，对贝类过敏会肿，跳水前约一小时进过食。我们从到场起全程维持徒手轴线固定；他前额有与撞击水底相符的擦伤，因此全套脊柱防护措施一直保留。
